f.title: Comply with Algerian PV regulation, inform headquarters and implement compliance measures
f.statement: Registration holders or operators, including those belonging to multinational groups, are required to comply with the Algerian regulation in force, to inform their headquarters of it, and to implement all measures necessary to comply with it, in collaboration with the authorities, each within its area of competence.
f.clause: Préface

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator, including members of multinational groups
rows.quote: À ce titre, les détenteurs ou exploitants de décisions d’enregistrement , y compris ceux appartenant à des groupes multinationaux, sont tenus de respecter la réglementation algérienne en vigueur, d’en informer leurs sièges et de mettre en œuvre toutes les mesures nécessaires pour s’y conformer, en collaboration avec les autorités chacune dans son domaine de compétence.
rows.location: Préface
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote proves actor, modal verb and the whole statement; level, actor, RACI and taxonomy confirmed. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Accordingly, holders or operators of registration decisions, including those belonging to multinational groups, are required to comply with the Algerian regulation in force, to inform their headquarters of it and to implement all measures necessary to comply with it, in collaboration with the authorities, each within its area of competence.

f.title: Implement and maintain a PV system compliant with the Algerian BPPV
f.statement: Pharmaceutical establishments (registration holders, operators, manufacturers or distributors) have the obligation and the ethical responsibility to ensure continuous monitoring of the safety of their products in line with national requirements. Implementing and maintaining a pharmacovigilance system that complies with this Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPPV) guide is a regulatory requirement; the guide sets the minimum obligations on organisation, resources, safety data management, communication, documentation and quality, and every pharmaceutical establishment authorised to operate in Algeria must comply with it strictly.
f.clause: Chapitre II : Rôles et responsabilités des établissements pharmaceutiques en matière de pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical establishments (registration holders, operators, manufacturers or distributors)
rows.quote: Ils ont l’obligation et la responsabilité éthique de garantir la surveillance continue de la sécurité de leurs produits, en conformité avec les exigences nationales en vigueur. La mise en œuvre et le maintien d’un système de pharmacovigilance conforme au présent guide des Bonnes Pratiques de Pharmacovigilance (BPPV) constituent une exigence réglementaire. Ce guide définit les obligations minimales attendues en matière d’organisation, de ressources, de gestion des données de sécurité, de communication, de documentation et de qualité. Tout établissement pharmaceutique autorisé à exercer en Algérie doit s’y conformer strictement
rows.location: Chapitre II : Rôles et responsabilités des établissements pharmaceutiques en matière de pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: Quote extended back to include the preceding sentence on the obligation and ethical responsibility for continuous safety monitoring; statement completed. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because first sentence's subject "Ils" is resolved from text before the quote. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: They have the obligation and the ethical responsibility to guarantee continuous monitoring of the safety of their products, in compliance with the national requirements in force. The implementation and maintenance of a pharmacovigilance system compliant with this Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPPV) guide constitute a regulatory requirement. This guide defines the minimum obligations expected regarding organisation, resources, safety data management, communication, documentation and quality. Every pharmaceutical establishment authorised to operate in Algeria must comply with it strictly

f.title: Adapt the application of the quality system to the importance of each PV task
f.statement: The application of the quality system must be adapted to the importance of each pharmacovigilance task in order to achieve the quality objectives for each pharmaceutical product covered by the quality system.
f.clause: Chapitre II, 1. Système qualité

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator; institutions of the national PV system
rows.quote: l’application du système qualité doit être adaptée à l’importance de chaque tâche de pharmacovigilance pour atteindre les objectifs qualité de chaque produit pharmaceutique couvert par ce système qualité.
rows.location: Chapitre II, 1. Système qualité
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote; actor also includes national PV institutions. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: the application of the quality system must be adapted to the importance of each pharmacovigilance task in order to achieve the quality objectives of each pharmaceutical product covered by this quality system.

f.title: Cover responsibilities, procedures, resources, compliance and record management in the quality system
f.statement: The quality system, part of the pharmacovigilance system, must cover responsibilities; procedures and processes; the resources of the pharmacovigilance system; appropriate resource management; compliance management; and record management.
f.clause: I.1.2. Exigences et objectifs du système qualité

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator; institutions of the national PV system
rows.quote: Le système qualité fait partie du système de pharmacovigilance et comprend ses propres structures et processus. Il doit couvrir : − Les responsabilités ; − Les procédures et processus ; − Les ressources du système de pharmacovigilance ; − La gestion appropriée des ressources ; − La gestion de la conformité ; − La gestion des enregistrements
rows.location: I.1.2. Exigences et objectifs du système qualité
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote; actor also includes national PV institutions. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The quality system is part of the pharmacovigilance system and comprises its own structures and processes. It must cover: − responsibilities; − procedures and processes; − the resources of the pharmacovigilance system; − appropriate management of resources; − compliance management; − record management

f.title: Base the quality system on quality planning, adherence, control/assurance and improvement
f.statement: The quality system must be based on quality planning (establishing structures and planning integrated, consistent processes), quality adherence (performing tasks in line with quality requirements), quality control and assurance (monitoring and evaluating how effectively structures and processes are established and executed) and quality improvement (correcting and improving structures and processes where necessary).
f.clause: I.1.3 Cycle de qualité

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator; institutions of the national PV system
rows.quote: Le système qualité doit être basé sur toutes les activités suivantes : − Planification de la qualité : établir des structures et planifier des processus intégrés et cohérents ; − Adhésion à la qualité : réaliser les tâches et responsabilités conformément aux exigences qualité ; − Contrôle et assurance qualité : surveiller et évaluer l’efficacité de l’établissement des structures et processus ainsi que l’exécution des processus ; − Améliorations de la qualité : corriger et améliorer les structures et processus si nécessaire.
rows.location: I.1.3 Cycle de qualité
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote; actor also includes national PV institutions. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The quality system must be based on all of the following activities: − Quality planning: establishing structures and planning integrated and consistent processes; − Quality adherence: carrying out tasks and responsibilities in accordance with quality requirements; − Quality control and assurance: monitoring and evaluating how effectively structures and processes have been established and how effectively processes are being carried out; − Quality improvements: correcting and improving structures and processes where necessary.

f.title: Apply the good PV practice principles to all structures, processes and tasks
f.statement: To achieve the overall quality objectives, the listed principles must guide the design of all structures and processes and the performance of all tasks and responsibilities: the safety needs of patients, healthcare professionals and the public must be met; management must provide leadership in implementing the quality system and motivate all staff towards the quality objectives; all persons in the organisation must be involved in and support the PV system according to their assigned tasks; and all stakeholders must commit to continuous quality improvement following the quality cycle (I.1.3).
f.clause: I.1.5. Principes des bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator; institutions of the national PV system
rows.quote: Afin d’atteindre les objectifs de qualité globaux, les principes suivants doivent guider la conception de toutes les structures et processus ainsi que l’exécution de toutes les tâches et responsabilités : − Les besoins des patients, professionnels de santé et du public en matière de sécurité des produits pharmaceutiques doivent être satisfaits ; − La direction doit fournir un leadership dans la mise en œuvre du système qualité et motiver l’ensemble du personnel en lien avec les objectifs qualité ; − Toutes les personnes au sein de l’organisation doivent être impliquées et soutenir le système de pharmacovigilance en fonction de la propriété des tâches et responsabilités qui leur sont assignées ; − Tous les intervenants doivent s’engager dans une amélioration continue de la qualité selon le cycle décrit au point I.1.3 ;
rows.location: I.1.5. Principes des bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: Missed bullet 'Tous les intervenants doivent s'engager dans une amélioration continue' (last line before the page break) added to the quote and statement. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote; actor also includes national PV institutions. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: In order to achieve the overall quality objectives, the following principles must guide the design of all structures and processes as well as the performance of all tasks and responsibilities: − The needs of patients, healthcare professionals and the public with regard to the safety of pharmaceutical products must be met; − Management must provide leadership in implementing the quality system and motivate all staff in relation to the quality objectives; − All persons within the organisation must be involved in and support the pharmacovigilance system according to their ownership of the tasks and responsibilities assigned to them; − All stakeholders must commit to continuous quality improvement following the cycle described in point I.1.3;

f.title: Organise PV proactively and risk-proportionately and seek all benefit-risk evidence
f.statement: Resources and tasks must be organised into structures and processes that support proactive, risk-proportionate, continuous and integrated pharmacovigilance; all available evidence on the benefit-risk balance must be sought and all relevant aspects that could affect it and the use of the product must be considered in decision-making; and good cooperation must be encouraged between registration holders or operators, the national PV system institutions, public health organisations, patients, healthcare professionals, learned societies and other relevant bodies in line with applicable legal provisions.
f.clause: I.1.5. Principes des bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator; institutions of the national PV system
rows.quote: − Les ressources et tâches doivent être organisées en structures et processus favorisant une conduite proactive, proportionnée aux risques, continue et intégrée de la pharmacovigilance ; − Toutes les preuves disponibles sur le rapport bénéfice-risque des produits pharmaceutiques doivent être recherchées et tous les aspects pertinents susceptibles d’impacter ce rapport et l’utilisation du produit doivent être pris en compte pour la prise de décision ; − Une bonne coopération doit être encouragée entre les détenteurs ou exploitants de la DE, institutions du système national de pharmacovigilance, les organisations de santé publique, les patients, les professionnels de santé, les sociétés savantes et autres organismes concernés conformément aux dispositions légales applicables.
rows.location: I.1.5. Principes des bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote; actor also includes national PV institutions. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: − Resources and tasks must be organised into structures and processes that promote proactive, risk-proportionate, continuous and integrated conduct of pharmacovigilance; − All available evidence on the benefit-risk balance of pharmaceutical products must be sought, and all relevant aspects that may affect that balance and the use of the product must be taken into account for decision-making; − Good cooperation must be encouraged between holders or operators of the registration decision, institutions of the national pharmacovigilance system, public health organisations, patients, healthcare professionals, learned societies and other relevant bodies in accordance with the applicable legal provisions.

f.title: Have sufficient competent, qualified and trained staff for PV activities
f.statement: A sufficient number of competent, qualified and trained staff must be available to perform pharmacovigilance activities; their responsibilities include respecting the principles in I.1.5.
f.clause: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Un nombre suffisant de personnels compétents, qualifiés et formés doit être disponible pour réaliser les activités de pharmacovigilance. Leur responsabilité inclut le respect des principes définis au point I.1.5.
rows.location: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: A sufficient number of competent, qualified and trained staff must be available to carry out pharmacovigilance activities. Their responsibility includes compliance with the principles defined in point I.1.5.

f.title: Management to document the quality system, control documents and ensure resources, premises and compliance
f.statement: Staff with managerial responsibilities must ensure that the organisation documents the quality system (I.1.11); ensure that quality system documents are under document control for their creation, revision, approval and implementation; guarantee adequate resources and staff training (I.1.7); ensure suitable premises, equipment and facilities (I.1.8); ensure adequate compliance management (I.1.9); and ensure appropriate record management (I.1.10).
f.clause: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation

rows.actor: Management personnel of the registration holder or operator
rows.quote: Pour une approche systématique de la qualité selon le cycle qualité, le personnel de gestion (ayant des responsabilités managériales) doit : − Veiller à ce que l’organisation documente le système qualité comme décrit au point I.1.11; − S’assurer que les documents décrivant le système qualité soient soumis à un contrôle documentaire relatif à leur création, révision, approbation et mise en œuvre ; − Garantir la disponibilité des ressources adéquates et la formation du personnel (voir I.1.7); − Veiller à la disponibilité de locaux, équipements et installations adaptés (voir I.1.8) ; − Assurer une gestion adéquate de la conformité (voir I.1.9) ; − Assurer une gestion appropriée des enregistrements (voir I.1.10) ;
rows.location: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote proves actor, modal verb and the whole statement; level, actor, RACI and taxonomy confirmed. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: For a systematic approach to quality according to the quality cycle, management staff (with managerial responsibilities) must: − ensure that the organisation documents the quality system as described in point I.1.11; − ensure that the documents describing the quality system are subject to document control regarding their creation, revision, approval and implementation; − guarantee the availability of adequate resources and staff training (see I.1.7); − ensure the availability of suitable premises, equipment and facilities (see I.1.8); − ensure adequate compliance management (see I.1.9); − ensure appropriate record management (see I.1.10);

f.title: Management to review the PV system, ensure escalation channels, investigate non-compliance and ensure audits
f.statement: Management staff must regularly review the pharmacovigilance system, including the quality system, using a risk-based approach to verify its effectiveness and put corrective and preventive actions in place where necessary; ensure rapid and effective communication mechanisms, including escalation of product safety concerns within the organisation; identify and investigate concerns about suspected non-compliance with quality and PV system requirements and take necessary corrective, preventive and escalation action; and ensure that audits are performed.
f.clause: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation

rows.actor: Management personnel of the registration holder or operator
rows.quote: − Réviser régulièrement le système de pharmacovigilance, y compris le système qualité, selon une approche basée sur les risques pour vérifier son efficacité (voir I.1.12) et mettre en place des mesures correctives et préventives si nécessaire ; − Veiller à l’existence de mécanismes de communication rapide et efficace, y compris les processus d’escalade des préoccupations de sécurité liées aux produits pharmaceutiques au sein de l’organisation ; − Identifier et enquêter sur les préoccupations relatives au non-respect supposé des exigences des systèmes qualité et pharmacovigilance et prendre les mesures correctives, préventives et d’escalade nécessaires ; − Veiller à la réalisation d’audits (voir I.1.12).
rows.location: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because quote is a list continuation without its lead-in, so the modal and actor come from text outside the quote (continues the management list in 0009). Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: − regularly review the pharmacovigilance system, including the quality system, using a risk-based approach to verify its effectiveness (see I.1.12) and put in place corrective and preventive actions where necessary; − ensure that rapid and effective communication mechanisms exist, including processes for escalating safety concerns relating to pharmaceutical products within the organisation; − identify and investigate concerns about suspected non-compliance with the requirements of the quality and pharmacovigilance systems and take the necessary corrective, preventive and escalation actions; − ensure that audits are carried out (see I.1.12).

f.title: Top management to assign roles by competence and ensure the PV system description reflects reality
f.statement: Senior management must provide leadership by motivating all staff and by assigning roles, responsibilities and authorities according to competence and communicating and implementing these assignments throughout the organisation. It must also ensure that the document describing the pharmacovigilance system reflects the reality and robustness of the system.
f.clause: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation

rows.actor: Senior management (direction générale) of the registration holder or operator
rows.quote: La direction générale doit assurer le leadership par : − La motivation de tout le personnel, fondée sur des valeurs partagées, la confiance, la liberté d’expression et d’action responsable, ainsi que la reconnaissance des contributions des membres du personnel; − L’attribution des rôles, responsabilités et autorités selon les compétences, et la communication et mise en œuvre de ces attributions dans toute l’organisation. Elle doit aussi s’assurer que le document descriptif du système de pharmacovigilance reflète la réalité et la robustesse du système.
rows.location: I.1.6. Responsabilités du système qualité au sein d’une organisation
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote proves actor, modal verb and the whole statement; level, actor, RACI and taxonomy confirmed. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Senior management must provide leadership through: − motivating all staff, based on shared values, trust, freedom of expression and responsible action, and recognition of staff members' contributions; − assigning roles, responsibilities and authorities according to competence, and communicating and implementing these assignments throughout the organisation. It must also ensure that the document describing the pharmacovigilance system reflects the reality and robustness of the system.

f.title: Give all PV staff initial and continuous training on their roles, with ongoing effectiveness evaluation
f.statement: All staff involved in pharmacovigilance activities must receive initial and continuous training. For registration holders or operators, this training must cover staff roles and responsibilities, with continuous evaluation of the effectiveness of the training delivered.
f.clause: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Tout le personnel impliqué dans les activités de pharmacovigilance doit recevoir une formation initiale et continue. Pour les détenteurs ou exploitants de la DE, cette formation doit porter sur les rôles et responsabilités du personnel, avec une évaluation continue de l’efficacité des formations dispensées.
rows.location: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote proves actor, modal verb and the whole statement; level, actor, RACI and taxonomy confirmed. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: All staff involved in pharmacovigilance activities must receive initial and continuous training. For holders or operators of the registration decision, this training must cover the roles and responsibilities of staff, with continuous evaluation of the effectiveness of the training delivered.

f.title: Keep needs-based training plans and records and monitor them
f.statement: The organisation must keep training plans and records to document, maintain and develop staff competence. The plans must be based on a needs assessment and be monitored.
f.clause: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: L’organisation doit conserver des plans et registres de formation pour documenter, maintenir et développer les compétences du personnel. Ces plans doivent être basés sur une évaluation des besoins et faire l’objet d’un suivi.
rows.location: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because "organisation" in I.1 covers holders and institutions; actor inferred. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: The organisation must keep training plans and records to document, maintain and develop staff competence. These plans must be based on a needs assessment and be monitored.

f.title: Ensure training gives staff appropriate qualifications and verify training effectiveness
f.statement: Training must support continuous improvement of competence, application of scientific advances and professional development, and ensure staff have the qualifications, understanding of PV requirements and experience appropriate to their tasks. A process must be in place to verify that training leads to appropriate levels of understanding and conduct of PV activities, or to identify unmet needs, in line with professional development plans.
f.clause: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: La formation doit soutenir l’amélioration continue des compétences, l’application des progrès scientifiques et le développement professionnel, et garantir que le personnel possède les qualifications, la compréhension des exigences de pharmacovigilance et l’expérience appropriées pour les tâches assignées. Un processus doit être en place pour vérifier que la formation conduit aux niveaux appropriés de compréhension et de conduite des activités de pharmacovigilance ou pour identifier les besoins non satisfaits, conformément aux plans de développement professionnel.
rows.location: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Training must support continuous improvement of competence, the application of scientific advances and professional development, and ensure that staff have the qualifications, understanding of pharmacovigilance requirements and experience appropriate to the tasks assigned. A process must be in place to verify that training leads to appropriate levels of understanding and conduct of pharmacovigilance activities, or to identify unmet needs, in accordance with professional development plans.

f.title: Consider PV training for non-PV staff whose activities can affect the PV system
f.statement: Adequate training must also be considered for staff without specific pharmacovigilance tasks whose activities may affect the PV system or the conduct of PV (e.g. clinical trials, technical complaints, medical information, regulatory and legal affairs, audits).
f.clause: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Une formation adéquate doit également être envisagée pour le personnel sans tâches spécifiques de pharmacovigilance mais dont les activités peuvent avoir un impact sur le système ou la conduite de la pharmacovigilance (ex. essais cliniques, plaintes techniques, information médicale, affaires réglementaires et juridiques, audits).
rows.location: I.1.7. Formation du personnel en pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Adequate training must also be considered for staff without specific pharmacovigilance tasks but whose activities may have an impact on the system or the conduct of pharmacovigilance (e.g. clinical trials, technical complaints, medical information, regulatory and legal affairs, audits).

f.title: Provide fit-for-purpose PV premises and equipment and qualify/validate critical ones
f.statement: PV premises and equipment (office space, IT systems and electronic storage) must be located, designed, built, adapted and maintained for their intended use in line with the quality objectives and be available for business continuity. Premises and equipment critical for pharmacovigilance must undergo appropriate checks, qualification and/or validation to prove their suitability.
f.clause: I.1.8. Locaux et équipements pour la pharmacovigilance
f.processes: Validation & change control; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Ils comprennent les espaces de bureau, systèmes informatiques et espaces de stockage (électroniques). Ils doivent être situés, conçus, construits, adaptés et entretenus pour leur usage prévu, conformément aux objectifs qualité et disponibles pour la continuité des activités (voir I.1.11.2). Les locaux et équipements critiques pour la pharmacovigilance doivent faire l’objet de contrôles, qualifications et/ou validations appropriés pour prouver leur adéquation.
rows.location: I.1.8. Locaux et équipements pour la pharmacovigilance
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: below 90 because subject "Ils" (premises and equipment) resolved from text before the quote; actor inferred from impersonal/passive wording and section context, not named in the quote. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: They include office space, IT systems and (electronic) storage space. They must be located, designed, constructed, adapted and maintained for their intended use, in accordance with the quality objectives, and be available for business continuity (see I.1.11.2). Premises and equipment critical for pharmacovigilance must be subject to appropriate checks, qualifications and/or validations to prove their suitability.

f.title: Have procedures for continuous PV data monitoring, risk-minimisation review and appropriate measures
f.statement: Registration holders and/or operators must have specific procedures for continuous monitoring of pharmacovigilance data, examination of risk minimisation and prevention options, and implementation of appropriate measures.
f.clause: I.1.9.1. Gestion de la conformité par les détenteurs ou exploitants de la DE
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Signal detection; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Les détenteurs et/ou exploitants de la décision d'enregistrement doivent disposer de procédures spécifiques pour : − La surveillance continue des données de pharmacovigilance, l’examen des options de minimisation et prévention des risques, et la mise en œuvre de mesures appropriées ;
rows.location: I.1.9.1. Gestion de la conformité par les détenteurs ou exploitants de la DE
rows.review_note: Review: Statement trimmed to the first bullet the quote proves; the other procedure bullets are covered by 0018 and 0019. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote proves actor, modal verb and the whole statement; level, actor, RACI and taxonomy confirmed; title trimmed to the first bullet the quote proves. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Holders and/or operators of the registration decision must have specific procedures for: − continuous monitoring of pharmacovigilance data, examination of risk minimisation and prevention options, and implementation of appropriate measures;

f.title: Have procedures for evaluating risk information and submitting adverse reaction data to the CNPM on time
f.statement: Registration holders and/or operators must also have specific procedures for: scientific evaluation of all information on product risks, in particular human adverse reactions within or outside the authorised conditions or linked to occupational exposure; submission of accurate and verifiable data on serious and non-serious adverse reactions to the CNPM within the legal deadlines; the quality, integrity and completeness of risk information, including processes to avoid duplicates and validate signals; and effective communication with the national PV system institutions, each within its competence (new risks, PSMF, risk management systems, risk minimisation measures, PSURs, CAPA and post-authorisation studies).
f.clause: I.1.9.1. Gestion de la conformité par les détenteurs ou exploitants de la DE
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Submission operations; ICSR quality control

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: − L’évaluation scientifique de toutes les informations sur les risques des produits, notamment les réactions indésirables humaines dans ou hors des conditions d’autorisation ou liées à l’exposition professionnelle ; − La soumission de données exactes et vérifiables sur les réactions indésirables graves et non graves au CNPM dans les délais légaux ; − La qualité, intégrité et exhaustivité des informations sur les risques, y compris les processus pour éviter les doublons et valider les signaux ; − La communication efficace avec les institutions du système national de pharmacovigilance, chacun de son domaine de compétence, notamment sur les nouveaux risques, le dossier permanent de pharmacovigilance, les systèmes de gestion des risques, les mesures de minimisation des risques, les rapports périodiques actualisés de sécurité, les actions correctives et préventives et les études post-autorisation ;
rows.location: I.1.9.1. Gestion de la conformité par les détenteurs ou exploitants de la DE

f.statement: The registration holder or operator in Algeria is responsible for its pharmacovigilance tasks and responsibilities for its authorised products. f.statement: The registration holder and/or operator must also guarantee that the QPPV/RLPV has access to the PSMF, is informed of any change to it and can make changes to it, and takes part in risk management plans and in the preparation of regulatory actions in case of safety concerns.

f.title: Provide structures and processes so the QPPV/RLPV receives all relevant safety information
f.statement: The registration holder and/or operator must put in place structures and processes enabling the QPPV/RLPV to fulfil their responsibilities and ensure the QPPV/RLPV receives all relevant information, including emerging safety signals and benefit-risk information, ongoing or completed clinical trials that may concern safety, and information from third-party sources, in particular contract-related.

f.title: Share QS review results, compliance data, audit plans and post-audit CAPA plans with the QPPV/RLPV
f.statement: Results of regular quality system reviews must be communicated to the QPPV/RLPV. Compliance data must be provided to them regularly. They must be informed of planned audits and may request audits. After each audit, the corrective and preventive action plan must be communicated to them.
f.clause: I.2.1.1 Responsabilités du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en relation avec la QPPV en Algérie

Il doit être informé des audits planifiés et peut demander des audits. Après chaque audit, le plan d’actions correctives et préventives doit lui être communiqué.

f.title: Give the QPPV/RLPV real-time access to the adverse reaction database
f.statement: The registration holder or operator must also ensure the QPPV/RLPV has real-time access to the adverse reaction database, in particular to respond rapidly to requests from the national PV system institutions.
f.clause: I.2.1.1 Responsabilités du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en relation avec la QPPV en Algérie

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Le détenteur ou exploitant doit également assurer l’accès en temps réel du QPPV/RLPV à la base de données des réactions indésirables, notamment pour répondre rapidement aux demandes des institutions du système national de pharmacovigilance.
rows.location: I.2.1.1 Responsabilités du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en relation avec la QPPV en Algérie

f.title: PDT to communicate QS review results and measures, and periodic compliance information, to the QPPV/RLPV
f.statement: The results of regular quality system reviews and the measures put in place must be communicated by the technical director pharmacist (PDT) to the QPPV/RLPV. Information on compliance of quality system processes must be provided periodically to the QPPV/RLPV; it may also be used to assure the QPPV/RLPV that commitments under risk management plans and post-authorisation safety systems are met.
f.clause: I.2.1.1 Responsabilités du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en relation avec la QPPV en Algérie

f.title: PDT to inform the QPPV/RLPV of planned audits; QPPV/RLPV can trigger audits and sets up CAPA with the PDT
f.statement: The PDT must also inform the QPPV/RLPV of planned pharmacovigilance audits. The QPPV/RLPV must be able to trigger an audit where appropriate. After an audit of the PV system under their responsibility, the QPPV/RLPV, in coordination with the PDT, puts in place the corrective and preventive action plan where applicable.

Après un audit portant sur le système de pharmacovigilance dont le QPPV/RLPV a la charge, le QPPV/RLPV, en coordination avec le PDT, met en place, le cas échéant, le plan d’actions correctives et préventives.

f.title: Inform and involve the QPPV/RLPV early when preparing partnership agreements affecting the PV system
f.statement: When the registration holder intends to establish a partnership with another holder, organisation or person having a direct or indirect impact on the PV system, the QPPV/RLPV must be informed early enough and involved in preparing the corresponding contractual agreements so that all necessary PV provisions are included.
f.clause: I.2.1.1 Responsabilités du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en relation avec la QPPV en Algérie

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Lorsque le titulaire de DE envisage d’établir un partenariat avec un autre titulaire de DE, organisation ou personne ayant un impact direct ou indirect sur le système de pharmacovigilance, le QPPV/RLPV doit être informé suffisamment tôt et impliqué dans la préparation des accords contractuels correspondants afin que toutes les dispositions nécessaires relatives au système de pharmacovigilance soient incluses.
rows.location: I.2.1.1 Responsabilités du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en relation avec la QPPV en Algérie

f.title: Appoint a QPPV/RLPV who is a pharmacist with at least two consecutive years of PV experience and resides in Algeria
f.statement: To be eligible as QPPV/RLPV, in addition to the recruiting establishment's own requirements, the person must hold a Pharmacist or Doctor of Pharmacy diploma, have experience in all aspects of pharmacovigilance and PV systems of at least two consecutive years, and reside in Algeria. Transitionally and for a period of 2 years, the QPPV/RLPV's qualifications may be expressed by PV training rather than practical PV experience.
f.clause: I.2.1.2 Qualifications de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Outre des exigences propres à l’Établissement Pharmaceutique recruteur, pour être éligible au poste de QPPV/RLPV, la personne doit être titulaire du diplôme de Pharmacien ou de Docteur en Pharmacie, jouir d’une expérience dans tous les aspects de la pharmacovigilance et des systèmes de pharmacovigilance d’au moins deux années consécutives et résider en Algérie. De manière transitoire et pour une durée de 02 ans, les qualifications du QPPV/RLPV peuvent être exprimées par sa formation en pharmacovigilance plutôt que par son expérience pratique en pharmacovigilance.

On a transitional basis and for a period of 02 years, the qualifications of the QPPV/RLPV may be expressed by their training in pharmacovigilance rather than by their practical experience in pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Train the QPPV/RLPV on the company PV system and product safety profiles before taking up duties; refresh every two years
f.statement: The pharmaceutical establishment holding or operating the registration is obliged to train the QPPV/RLPV on the establishment's specific PV system; to train the QPPV/RLPV on the therapeutic and pharmaceutical properties, side effects and generally the safety profiles of the authorised products before they take up their duties; and to provide continuous refresher training every two years.

f.title: Employ the QPPV/RLPV on a fixed-term or permanent contract and ensure adequate PV knowledge
f.statement: The QPPV/RLPV is recruited on a fixed-term (CDD) or permanent (CDI) contract to ensure permanent and continuous availability. The registration holder or operator must ensure the QPPV/RLPV has acquired adequate theoretical and practical knowledge for PV activities. The QPPV/RLPV must hold at least a Doctor of Pharmacy diploma, and at least two years of practice in PV and PV systems is required.
f.clause: I.2.1.2 Qualifications de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Le QPPV/RLPV est recrutée en Contrat à Durée déterminée(CDD) ou indéterminée (CDI) pour s’assurer de sa disponibilité permanente et continue. Le détenteur ou exploitant de la DE doit s’assurer que le QPPV/RLPV a acquis des connaissances théoriques et pratiques adéquates pour l’exercice des activités de pharmacovigilance. Le QPPV/RLPV doit disposer au minimum d’un diplôme de Docteur en pharmacie. Une expérience de deux années au minimum de pratique de la PV et des systèmes de PV est requise.
rows.location: I.2.1.2 Qualifications de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

The holder or operator of the registration decision must ensure that the QPPV/RLPV has acquired adequate theoretical and practical knowledge for performing pharmacovigilance activities. The QPPV/RLPV must hold at least a Doctor of Pharmacy diploma. Experience of at least two years of practice in PV and PV systems is required.

f.title: Provide missing training to a QPPV/RLPV appointed under the transitional training-based qualification
f.statement: Where recruitment within the regulatory deadlines is difficult, the national PV system institutions accept, for a transitional period only, that the QPPV/RLPV's qualifications be expressed by PV training rather than practical experience. When the QPPV/RLPV is appointed, the holder or operator must provide the missing training.

f.title: QPPV/RLPV to act as 24-hour single PV contact point and inspection contact
f.statement: The QPPV/RLPV acts as the single point of contact for pharmacovigilance with the national PV system institutions 24 hours a day and as the contact point for pharmacovigilance inspections.

f.title: QPPV/RLPV to establish and maintain the PV system and verify the PSMF reflects it accurately
f.statement: The QPPV/RLPV is responsible for establishing and maintaining the holder's/operator's PV system and must therefore have sufficient authority to influence the quality system and PV activities and to promote, maintain and improve compliance. Consequently the QPPV/RLPV must have access to the PSMF and be in a position of authority to ensure and verify that the PSMF accurately and currently reflects the PV system under their responsibility.
f.clause: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

Par conséquent, le QPPV/RLPV doit avoir accès au PSMF et être en position d’autorité pour s’assurer et vérifier que les informations contenues dans le PSMF reflètent fidèlement et de manière actualisée le système de pharmacovigilance sous sa responsabilité.

Consequently, the QPPV/RLPV must have access to the PSMF and be in a position of authority to ensure and verify that the information contained in the PSMF faithfully reflects, in an up-to-date manner, the pharmacovigilance system under their responsibility.

f.title: QPPV/RLPV to oversee safety profiles, authorisation conditions, RMM and RMP content
f.statement: For products covered by the PV system, the QPPV/RLPV's additional specific responsibilities include: an overview of product safety profiles and any emerging safety concern; awareness of conditions or obligations adopted in marketing authorisations and other safety commitments; being informed of risk minimisation measures; and awareness of and sufficient authority over RMP content.

rows.quote_en: With regard to the pharmaceutical products covered by the pharmacovigilance system, the additional specific responsibilities of the QPPV/RLPV include: − having an overview of the safety profiles of the pharmaceutical products and of any emerging safety concern; − being aware of the conditions or obligations adopted in the marketing authorisations and other commitments relating to safety or the safe use of products; − being informed of risk minimisation measures; − having awareness of, and sufficient authority over, the content of risk management plans;

f.title: QPPV/RLPV to ensure PV submissions, data quality and complete, rapid answers to ANPP requests
f.statement: The QPPV/RLPV's responsibilities also include: ensuring PV activities are performed and all PV documents submitted in line with national legal requirements; ensuring the necessary quality, including accuracy and completeness, of PV data submitted to the national PV system institutions; guaranteeing a complete and rapid response to any ANPP request for additional information needed for benefit-risk evaluation; and contributing to the preparation of regulatory actions in response to emerging safety concerns (variations, urgent safety restrictions, communication to patients and healthcare professionals).
f.clause: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

rows.actor: QPPV/RLPV
rows.quote: − Veiller à la réalisation des activités de pharmacovigilance et à la soumission de tous les documents liés à la pharmacovigilance conformément aux exigences légales nationales ; − Assurer la qualité nécessaire, incluant l’exactitude et l’intégralité, des données de pharmacovigilance soumises aux institutions du système national de pharmacovigilance ; − Garantir une réponse complète et rapide à toute demande de l’ANPP pour des informations complémentaires nécessaires à l’évaluation bénéfice-risque d’un produit pharmaceutique ; − Apporter une contribution à la préparation des actions réglementaires en réponse à des préoccupations de sécurité émergentes (variations, restrictions de sécurité urgentes, communication aux patients et professionnels de santé) ;
rows.location: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

f.title: QPPV/RLPV to oversee all aspects of the PV system including SOPs, contracts, database, compliance and training
f.statement: This responsibility means the QPPV/RLPV oversees the functioning of the system in all relevant aspects, including its quality system (standard operating procedures, contractual agreements, database operations, quality compliance data, completeness and timeliness of expedited reports and periodic update reports, audits and PV staff training).

rows.location: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

f.title: Inform the QPPV/RLPV of database validation status, failures, CAPA and significant changes
f.statement: Regarding the adverse reaction database, the QPPV/RLPV must be informed of the database validation status, any failures during validation and the corrective actions implemented, and of significant changes made to the database (e.g. those that may affect PV activities).
f.clause: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Plus précisément, concernant la base de données des réactions indésirables, le QPPV/RLPV doit être informé du statut de validation de la base de données, des éventuels échecs survenus lors de la validation et des actions correctives mises en œuvre. Elle doit également être informée de changements significatifs apportés à la base de données (par exemple ceux pouvant affecter les activités de pharmacovigilance).
rows.location: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

f.title: QPPV/RLPV may delegate specific tasks under supervision; document the delegation
f.statement: The QPPV/RLPV may delegate specific tasks, under supervision, to qualified and trained persons (e.g. as safety experts for certain products), provided they retain oversight of the system and an overview of the safety profiles of all products. This delegation must be documented.
f.clause: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie

Cette délégation doit être documentée.

f.title: Put quality processes in place for timely submission of adverse reaction data to the CNPM and terminology checks
f.statement: Applying I.1.9.1, the registration holder and/or operator must put in place additional quality processes to guarantee timely submission of adverse reaction data to the CNPM and monitoring of correct use of terminology through regular systematic or random evaluation.
f.clause: I.2.1.4 Processus qualité spécifiques du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en Algérie
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Submission operations; Terminology governance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: En appliquant les exigences définies en I.1.9.1., le titulaire et /ou l’exploitant de DE doit mettre en place les processus qualité supplémentaires suivants afin de garantir : − La soumission des données de réactions indésirables au CNPM dans les délais ; − Le suivi de l’utilisation correcte de la terminologie par évaluation systématique ou aléatoire régulière ;
rows.location: I.2.1.4 Processus qualité spécifiques du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en Algérie

f.title: Retain the minimum PSMF elements while the system exists and at least 5 years after it is formally terminated
f.statement: The registration holder and/or operator must have quality processes guaranteeing retention of the minimum PSMF elements as long as the system described in the PSMF exists and for at least 5 years after that system is formally terminated by the holder/operator.
f.clause: I.2.1.4 Processus qualité spécifiques du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en Algérie

f.title: Ensure retrievability during retention; validated electronic archiving; legible paper-to-electronic transfer
f.statement: During retention periods, it must be possible to retrieve documents. Documents may be kept electronically provided the electronic system has been suitably validated and adequate measures exist for system security, access and data back-up. If paper documents are transferred to electronic format, the procedure must ensure all original information is kept legibly and the storage medium remains readable over time.
f.clause: I.2.1.4 Processus qualité spécifiques du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en Algérie
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Validation & change control

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Pendant ces périodes de conservation, la possibilité de retrouver les documents doit être assurée. Les documents peuvent être conservés au format électronique, à condition que le système électronique ait été convenablement validé et que des mesures adéquates existent pour la sécurité du système, l’accès et la sauvegarde des données. Si des documents papier sont transférés en format électronique, la procédure doit garantir que toutes les informations originales sont conservées de manière lisible et que le support de stockage reste lisible dans le temps.

If paper documents are transferred into electronic format, the procedure must guarantee that all original information is kept legibly and that the storage medium remains readable over time.

f.title: Use harmonised, standardised terminologies for PV information
f.statement: For classification, retrieval, presentation, benefit-risk evaluation, electronic exchange and communication of pharmacovigilance and pharmaceutical information, holders and/or operators and the national PV system institutions must use harmonised and standardised terminologies.
f.clause: I.2.1.4 Processus qualité spécifiques du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en Algérie – Utilisation de la terminologie internationale reconnue

rows.quote: Pour la classification, la recherche, la présentation, l’évaluation bénéfice-risque, l’échange électronique et la communication d’informations pharmacovigilance et pharmaceutiques, les détenteurs et/ou exploitants, les institutions du système national de pharmacovigilance doivent utiliser les terminologies harmonisées et normalisées.
rows.location: I.2.1.4 Processus qualité spécifiques du détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE en Algérie – Utilisation de la terminologie internationale reconnue

f.title: Outsource PV activities, including the QPPV/RLPV role, while keeping ultimate responsibility
f.statement: The registration holder or operator may subcontract certain PV system activities to PV service providers, which may include the QPPV/RLPV role. However, final responsibility for the completeness and accuracy of the PSMF, and ultimate responsibility for all PV tasks and for the quality and integrity of the PV system, always remain with the holder or operator.
f.clause: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Le détenteur ou exploitant de la DE peut sous-traiter certaines activités du système de pharmacovigilance à des organisations prestataires de services en Pharmacovigilance. Cela peut inclure le rôle du QPPV/RLPV. Cependant, la responsabilité finale de la complétude et l’exactitude du PSMF revient toujours au détenteur ou exploitant. La responsabilité ultime de l’exécution de toutes les tâches et responsabilités de pharmacovigilance ainsi que de la qualité et de l’intégrité du système de pharmacovigilance revient toujours au détenteur ou exploitant.
rows.location: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE
rows.review_note: Review: Level kept Permitted: the operative verb is 'peut sous-traiter'. Double-check: below 90 because level kept Permitted ("peut sous-traiter"); the retained-responsibility sentences are statements of principle, so the row mixes a permission with a binding principle. rows.quote_en: The holder or operator of the registration decision may subcontract certain activities of the pharmacovigilance system to pharmacovigilance service provider organisations. This may include the role of the QPPV/RLPV. However, final responsibility for the completeness and accuracy of the PSMF always lies with the holder or operator. Ultimate responsibility for the performance of all pharmacovigilance tasks and responsibilities, and for the quality and integrity of the pharmacovigilance system, always lies with the holder or operator.

f.title: Ensure an effective quality system covers outsourced tasks; keep detailed contracts and list them in the PSMF
f.statement: Where tasks are subcontracted, the holder or operator must ensure that an effective quality system applies to them; all guidance in the national guide applies to the subcontractor. When subcontracting to a PV service provider, the holder or operator must draw up detailed, up-to-date contracts clearly documenting the agreements, delegation arrangements and each party's responsibilities. A description of subcontracted activities/services must be included in the PSMF with a list of contracts in an annex specifying the products concerned.
f.clause: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Lorsqu’un détenteur ou exploitant a sous-traité certaines tâches, il doit s’assurer qu’un système qualité efficace s’applique à ces tâches. Toutes les orientations fournies dans le guide national s’appliquent à l’organisation sous-traitante. Lors de la sous-traitance à une organisation prestataire de services en pharmacovigilance, le détenteur ou exploitant doit rédiger des contrats, détaillés, à jour, documentant clairement les accords contractuels, décrivant les arrangements de délégation et les responsabilités de chaque partie. Une description des activités et/ou services sous-traités doit être incluse dans le PSMF ainsi qu’une liste des contrats en annexe, précisant les produits concernés.
rows.location: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote proves actor, modal verb and the whole statement; level, actor, RACI and taxonomy confirmed. Translation verified.

All guidance provided in the national guide applies to the subcontracting organisation. When subcontracting to a pharmacovigilance service provider organisation, the holder or operator must draw up detailed, up-to-date contracts clearly documenting the contractual agreements, describing the delegation arrangements and the responsibilities of each party. A description of the subcontracted activities and/or services must be included in the PSMF, together with a list of contracts in an annex, specifying the products concerned.

f.title: Define delegated tasks, data exchanges, timelines and compliance checks in PV contracts
f.statement: Contracts must be prepared so that each party can meet legal requirements. They must include sufficiently detailed descriptions of delegated tasks, interactions and data exchanges, and agreed definitions, tools, missions and timelines. They must also specify practical PV management and associated processes, including database maintenance, and indicate the means of continuously verifying compliance with the agreements.
f.clause: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Les contrats doivent être préparés afin de permettre le respect des exigences légales par chaque partie. Ils doivent inclure des descriptions suffisamment détaillées des tâches déléguées, des interactions et échanges de données, ainsi que des définitions, outils, missions et échéances convenues. Les contrats doivent aussi préciser la gestion pratique de la pharmacovigilance ainsi que les processus associés, y compris la maintenance des bases de données. Ils doivent indiquer les moyens pour vérifier de manière continue le respect des accords.
rows.location: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE

Contracts must also specify the practical management of pharmacovigilance and the associated processes, including database maintenance. They must indicate the means of continuously verifying compliance with the agreements.

f.title: Audit subcontracted PV organisations periodically on a risk basis or use other controls
f.statement: It is recommended that the holder and/or operator perform periodic risk-based audits of the subcontracted organisation or put other control methods in place.
f.clause: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE

rows.location: I.2.1.5 Exigences relatives au système qualité pour les tâches de pharmacovigilance sous-traitées par le détenteur ou exploitant de DE

f.statement: The QPPV/RLPV's specific responsibilities extend to post-authorisation safety studies conducted in Algeria or under a risk management plan approved in Algeria, and include having knowledge of the post-authorisation safety studies requested by the national PV system institutions, including their results.
f.clause: I.2.1.3 Rôle de la personne qualifiée responsable de la pharmacovigilance en Algérie
f.applicability: PASS conducted in Algeria or under an RMP approved in Algeria

f.title: Maintain a PSMF and make it available on request
f.statement: Registration holders and/or operators maintain and make available on request a pharmacovigilance system master file (PSMF) to strengthen the conduct of pharmacovigilance activities in Algeria. The PSMF is a detailed description of the PV system used by the holder for one or more authorised products.
f.clause: 2. Dossier Maître du Système de Pharmacovigilance PSMF

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Les détenteurs et/ou exploitants de la décision d'enregistrement « DE » maintiennent et mettent à disposition, sur demande, un dossier permanent du système de pharmacovigilance (Pharmacovigilance System Master File - PSMF) afin de renforcer la conduite des activités de pharmacovigilance en Algérie. Le PSMF est une description détaillée du système de pharmacovigilance utilisé par le détenteur de la DE concernant un ou plusieurs produits pharmaceutiques autorisés.
rows.location: 2. Dossier Maître du Système de Pharmacovigilance PSMF

The PSMF is a detailed description of the pharmacovigilance system used by the holder of the registration decision for one or more authorised pharmaceutical products.

f.title: Locate the PSMF at the main PV site or where the QPPV/RLPV works
f.statement: The PSMF must be located either at the site where the holder's or operator's main PV activities take place or at the site where the QPPV/RLPV works.

f.title: Multinationals: describe the Algerian PV sub-system within the global system and the RLPV role
f.statement: Multinational establishments holding/operating registrations must have an appropriate PV system in which the PV activities located in Algeria operate as part or sub-system of the global PV system. The PSMF content must reflect global availability of safety information for authorised products and local or regional activities. They must give a clear illustration of the key elements of the global system and the national sub-system, highlighting the RLPV role and specifying which PV activities are performed in Algeria and which at headquarters or globally, and their integration.
f.clause: 2. Dossier Maître du Système de Pharmacovigilance PSMF – établissements multinationaux
f.applicability: Multinational establishments

rows.actor: Multinational pharmaceutical establishments holding or operating registrations
rows.quote: Les établissements pharmaceutiques multinationaux détenteurs et/ou exploitants de DE doivent : • Disposer d’un système approprié de pharmacovigilance. Les activités de pharmacovigilance localisées en Algérie fonctionnent comme une partie ou un sous-système du système mondial de pharmacovigilance auquel elles sont intégrées. Le contenu du PSMF doit refléter la disponibilité globale des informations de sécurité relatives aux produits pharmaceutiques autorisés pour les multinationales, ainsi que les informations liées aux activités locales ou régionales ; • Fournir une illustration claire des éléments clés du système mondial de pharmacovigilance et du sous-système national, mettant en exergue le rôle du Responsable Local de Pharmacovigilance (RLPV), en précisant quelles activités de pharmacovigilance sont réalisées en Algérie et lesquelles sont réalisées au siège ou au niveau mondial, ainsi que leur intégration.
rows.location: 2. Dossier Maître du Système de Pharmacovigilance PSMF – établissements multinationaux
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: quote proves actor, modal verb and the whole statement; level, actor, RACI and taxonomy confirmed. Translation verified.
rows.quote_en: Multinational pharmaceutical establishments holding and/or operating registration decisions must: • have an appropriate pharmacovigilance system. The pharmacovigilance activities located in Algeria operate as a part or sub-system of the global pharmacovigilance system into which they are integrated. The content of the PSMF must reflect the global availability of safety information on authorised pharmaceutical products for multinationals, as well as information linked to local or regional activities; • provide a clear illustration of the key elements of the global pharmacovigilance system and of the national sub-system, highlighting the role of the Local Pharmacovigilance Officer (RLPV), specifying which pharmacovigilance activities are performed in Algeria and which are performed at headquarters or globally, and how they are integrated.

f.title: Multinationals: submit both the EU-GVP-accepted PSMF and a national Algerian PSMF
f.statement: For a multinational pharmaceutical establishment, two documents are required for submission: the PSMF accepted under European Good Pharmacovigilance Practices, on which this guide is based, and the national PSMF describing the key elements of the PV activities specific to the local level in Algeria.

f.title: Reflect global availability of safety information for products authorised in Algeria in the PSMF
f.statement: PSMF content and management apply regardless of the holder's or operator's organisational structure, including subcontracting, delegation or location of activities. PSMF content must reflect the global availability of safety information for products authorised in Algeria, not limited to local or regional activities.
f.clause: II.1. Structures et processus

Le contenu du PSMF doit refléter la disponibilité globale des informations de sécurité pour les produits pharmaceutiques autorisés en Algérie, sans être limité aux seules activités locales ou régionales.

f.title: Describe the PV system and document its compliance in the PSMF
f.statement: The PSMF must describe the PV system and document its compliance with current requirements. Besides meeting national requirements, it must contribute to the planning and conduct of audits by the holder/operator or applicant, to QPPV/RLPV oversight and to ANPP inspections or investigations.

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)

Outre le respect des prescriptions nationales, il doit contribuer à la planification et la conduite d’audits par le détenteur ou l'exploitant de la DE ou candidat détenteur de la DE, à la supervision par le QPPV/RLPV, ainsi qu’aux inspections ou investigations par l’ANPP.

f.title: Submit a PV system summary with QPPV/deputy and key staff details and a signed statement of PV means
f.statement: Except where PSMF accessibility provisions apply, when a submission is requested only a summary with the nominations of PV staff is required. The summary must include in particular: full contact details and data of the QPPV/RLPV, their deputy and key PV staff (identity card, official nomination letter, certificates, any changes); a statement signed by the applicant attesting that it has the means to fulfil the PV responsibilities in this guide; and the location of the PSMF for the product concerned (even where the PSMF covers all products marketed by the establishment).

Ce résumé doit inclure notamment : − Les coordonnées complètes et données du QPPV/RLPV et de son suppléant ainsi que des membres clés du personnel de pharmacovigilance (Carte d’identité, lettre officielle de nomination, certificats, changements éventuels...) ; − Une déclaration signée par le demandeur attestant qu’il dispose des moyens nécessaires pour remplir les responsabilités de pharmacovigilance énoncées dans ce guide ; − La localisation du PSMF pour le produit pharmaceutique concerné (même dans le cas où le PSMF n’est pas spécifique à un seul produit et détaille les activités de pharmacovigilance pour l’ensemble des produits commercialisés par un établissement pharmaceutique).

f.title: Keep the PSMF in Algeria unless main PV activities are abroad, subject to ANPP access and a local description
f.statement: The PSMF must be located at the site where the main PV activities take place or where the QPPV/RLPV works, whatever its format (paper or electronic). As a rule the PSMF must be in Algeria, except where the main activities take place abroad (e.g. multinationals); it is then located where the QPPV/RLPV works or where the main activities take place (e.g. headquarters in another country), provided, among other conditions, that the PSMF is accessible to the ANPP at all times.
f.clause: II.1.2.2 Localisation

En règle générale, le PSMF doit se trouver en Algérie sauf lorsque les principales activités ont lieu à l’étranger (ex. : ap multi-nationaux), auquel cas il sera situé soit là où le QPPV/RLPV exerce, soit là où s’effectuent les principales activités (ex. : au siège dans un autre pays), sous réserve que : − Le PSMF soit accessible à l’ANPP à tout moment ;

f.title: Notify the PSMF location to the ANPP and declare any change immediately; justify the main PV site
f.statement: Where the PSMF is located abroad, the local or affiliate office of the holder or operator must also hold a detailed description of local PV activities and of the PV system at local level. The PSMF location must be communicated to the ANPP and any change declared immediately for updating. The address must be a physical office of the holder or operator; for an electronic file, the address indicates the site where the data are accessible. In choosing the main PV site, the holder or operator must choose the most relevant site for the global system with appropriate justification. Where no main site is determined, the QPPV/RLPV's site applies.

L’adresse doit correspondre à un bureau physique du détenteur ou exploitant de la DE. En cas de dossier électronique, l’adresse indique le site où les données sont accessibles. f.title: Register every PSMF with the ANPP and notify any change immediately
f.statement: The ANPP keeps a centralised national list/database of PSMFs (status, location, QPPV/RLPV contacts, products). All PSMFs must be registered in it. The holder or operator must submit the information and immediately notify the ANPP of any change, in particular the PSMF location for each product.

Tous les PSMF doivent y être enregistrés. Le détenteur ou exploitant de la DE doit soumettre les informations et notifier immédiatement tout changement (notamment la localisation du PSMF pour chaque produit) à l’ANPP.

f.title: Document and manage transfers or delegation of PSMF responsibilities; inform the QPPV/RLPV of changes
f.statement: Any transfer or delegation of responsibilities and activities relating to the PSMF must be documented and managed to ensure the holder or operator meets its obligations. The QPPV/RLPV must be informed of any change affecting the PSMF so as to exercise their authority to improve the system.
f.clause: II.1.2.4 Transfert de responsabilités pour le PSMF

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Tout transfert ou délégation de responsabilités et activités liées au PSMF doit être documenté et géré, afin d’assurer que le détenteur ou l’exploitant respecte ses obligations. Le QPPV/RLPV doit être informé de tout changement impactant le PSMF pour lui permettre d’exercer son autorité afin d’améliorer le système.

f.title: Notify listed PSMF-related changes to the QPPV/RLPV without delay
f.statement: Changes to be notified without delay to the QPPV/RLPV include: PSMF updates or relocation communicated to the ANPP; addition of CAPA (e.g. after audits or inspections); QPPV/RLPV access to all information on deviations in the PV quality system; content changes affecting effectiveness, compliance or capacity; changes in how the PSMF is provided to the ANPP; transfer of significant PV activities to an operator (e.g. outsourcing PSUR production); inclusion of new products; and changes to existing products that may require a change or increased PV workload (e.g. new indications, studies, added territories).
f.clause: II.1.2.4 Transfert de responsabilités pour le PSMF

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)

f.title: Receiving QPPV/RLPV to accept PV system transfers expressly in writing; keep PSMF accurate and current
f.statement: The receiving QPPV/RLPV must expressly accept in writing any transfer of responsibility for the PV system. The QPPV/RLPV must guarantee that the PSMF information is accurate and up to date.

f.title: Use separate PV systems with separate PSMFs for different product categories, one QPPV/RLPV each
f.statement: For different product categories, the holder and/or operator may apply separate systems, each described in a separate PSMF, which together cover all authorised products. A single QPPV/RLPV is appointed responsible for establishing and maintaining each system described.
f.clause: II.1.3 Représentation des systèmes de pharmacovigilance

rows.quote: Pour différentes catégories de produits, le détenteur et/ou exploitant de la DE peut appliquer des systèmes distincts, chacun décrit dans un PSMF séparé, qui cumulativement couvrent tous les produits autorisés. Un seul QPPV/RLPV est nommé responsable de l’établissement et de la maintenance de chaque système décrit.

A single QPPV/RLPV is appointed responsible for establishing and maintaining each system described.

f.title: Ensure a PSMF exists for own products in a shared system; delegation by written agreement
f.statement: If a system is shared by several registration holders, each is responsible for ensuring a PSMF exists for its products. A holder and/or operator may delegate part or all PV activities by written agreement. Its PSMF may reference all or part of the operator's PSMF, subject to agreement on access to the information for the holder/operator and the ANPP. The holder must be able to guarantee the content of referenced files for the PV system applicable to its products. Maintenance and accessibility of the up-to-date PSMF may be delegated.
f.clause: II.1.3 Représentation des systèmes de pharmacovigilance

rows.actor: Registration holder or operator (détenteur ou exploitant de la DE)
rows.quote: Si un système est partagé par plusieurs détenteurs de la DE, chacun est responsable de s’assurer qu’un PSMF existe pour ses produits. Un détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE peut déléguer via un accord écrit une partie ou la totalité des activités pharmacovigilance. Le PSMF du détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE peut référencer tout ou une partie du PSMF à l’exploitant, sous réserve d’accord d’accès aux informations pour le détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE et l’ANPP. Le détenteur doit pouvoir garantir le contenu des dossiers référencés par rapport au système de pharmacovigilance applicable à son ou ses produits. La maintenance et l’accessibilité du PSMF à jour et accessible peuvent être déléguées.

rows.quote_en: If a system is shared by several holders of registration decisions, each is responsible for ensuring that a PSMF exists for its products. A holder and/or operator of a registration decision may delegate, by written agreement, part or all of the pharmacovigilance activities. The PSMF of the holder and/or operator may reference all or part of the PSMF of the operator, subject to an agreement on access to the information for the holder and/or operator and the ANPP. The holder must be able to guarantee the content of the referenced files in relation to the pharmacovigilance system applicable to its product(s). The maintenance and accessibility of the up-to-date and accessible PSMF may be delegated.

f.title: Annex a list of all the holder's PSMFs; give a single location per PSMF in the ANPP summary
f.statement: A list of all PSMFs of the same holder, with their location, responsible QPPV/RLPV and products concerned, must be provided in an annex. The summary submitted to the ANPP cannot indicate several locations for a single PSMF; the address given must be an office where the main PV activities are performed or where the QPPV/RLPV works.

Le résumé soumis à l’ANPP ne peut indiquer plusieurs locations pour un PSMF unique. L’adresse fournie doit être un bureau où s’exercent les principales activités pharmacovigilance ou où travaille le QPPV/RLPV.
rows.location: II.1.3 Représentation des systèmes de pharmacovigilance

rows.quote_en: A list of all the PSMFs of the same holder of the registration decision, with their location, responsible QPPV/RLPV and products concerned, must be provided in an annex. The summary submitted to the ANPP may not indicate several locations for a single PSMF. The address provided must be an office where the main pharmacovigilance activities are carried out or where the QPPV/RLPV works.

f.title: Remain ultimately responsible under delegation; have written agreements; inform ANPP immediately when a PV contract ends
f.statement: In case of delegation, the holder and/or operator remains ultimately responsible for the system and its obligations, notably providing the PSMF and necessary information to the ANPP; written agreements describing roles and responsibilities must be in place. When a PV contract ends, all partners must inform the ANPP immediately; the holder/operator remains responsible for safety monitoring of its products via its own system or a new operator.

rows.quote: En cas de délégation, le détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE reste responsable en dernier ressort du système et de ses obligations, notamment fournir le PSMF et les informations nécessaires à l’ANPP. Des accords écrits décrivant rôles et responsabilités doivent être en place. En cas de fin de contrat de pharmacovigilance, tous les partenaires doivent informer l’ANPP immédiatement. Le détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE reste responsable du suivi de sécurité de ses produits, que ce soit via son propre système ou un nouvel exploitant.
