f.title: Maintain a PV document management system (incl. signals) ensuring retrievability and traceability of actions, timelines and decisions
f.statement: The registration holder and/or operator must establish a document management system for all pharmacovigilance functions, including signal detection and management activities, ensuring that the corresponding documents can be retrieved and that the measures taken to examine safety concerns, the timelines of these examinations and the decisions taken on them, including dates and the decision-making process, are traceable.
f.clause: VIII.7 Gestion des enregistrements de signaux

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Le détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE doit mettre en place un système de gestion des documents pour toutes les fonctions de pharmacovigilance, y compris les activités de détection et de gestion des signaux, garantissant la possibilité de retrouver les documents correspondants ainsi que la traçabilité des mesures prises pour examiner les préoccupations relatives à la sécurité, les délais de ces examens et les décisions prises à leur sujet, y compris les dates et le processus décisionnel.

f.title: Audit the signal process regularly incl. vendor tasks; guarantee data confidentiality, security and validity incl. transfers
f.statement: As for any critical process, the signal management process must be subject to regular audits, including for tasks performed by any service provider or third party. The confidentiality (in accordance with applicable laws and regulations), security and validity of data and documents (including data integrity during their transfer between organisations) must be guaranteed.

f.clause: VIII.7 Gestion des enregistrements de signaux

La confidentialité (conformément aux lois et réglementations applicables), la sécurité et la validité des données et documents (y compris l’intégrité des données lors de leur transfert entre organisations) doivent être garanties.

f.title: If the notified signal meets ESI criteria, no standalone notification is required; comply with ESI notification timelines

f.title: If the PASS is a clinical trial, comply with Algerian national clinical trial regulations
f.statement: If the PASS is a clinical trial (i.e. an interventional study), the national clinical trial regulations and the national rules governing interventional clinical trials of pharmaceutical products in Algeria must be complied with.

f.title: Apply the legal requirements for imposed studies also to voluntary studies (protocols, abstracts, final reports, communication)
f.statement: Where applicable, the legal requirements applicable to mandatory studies are also recommended for studies conducted voluntarily, in order to ensure the same level of transparency, scientific standards and quality. This applies, for example, to the presentation of protocols, abstracts, final reports and the communication of information to the national competent pharmacovigilance authorities.

Cela s’applique, par exemple, à la présentation des protocoles, résumés, rapports finaux et la communication des informations aux autorités nationales compétentes en pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Have a written, scientifically valid PASS protocol before study start
f.statement: All PASS must have a written protocol before the start of the study, and the study must follow a scientifically valid protocol developed by persons with appropriate scientific training and experience.

L'étude doit suivre un protocole scientifiquement valable, élaboré par des personnes ayant GUIDE DE BONNES PRATIQUES DE PHARMACOVIGILANCES 152 une formation et une expérience scientifiques appropriées.

f.title: Submit the PASS protocol to the national PV authorities; the Algerian PV contact person must be informed and take part in protocol review/approval
f.statement: National requirements must be respected to guarantee the well-being and rights of participants. The registration holder and/or operator is required to submit the protocol to the national competent pharmacovigilance authorities. The pharmacovigilance contact person of the registration holder and/or operator in Algeria must be informed of any study sponsored or conducted by the registration holder and/or operator and must participate in the review and approval of the study protocols conducted. The registration holder and/or operator and the person responsible for pharmacovigilance must meet any requirement formulated by the national pharmacovigilance authorities during the study period.

f.title: Record substantial amendments traceably with dates; immediately inform the authority if the study becomes interventional
f.statement: Any substantial amendment to the protocol after the start of the study is recorded in the protocol in a traceable and verifiable manner, including the dates of the amendments. If the amendments to the protocol mean that the study is considered an interventional clinical trial, the national competent pharmacovigilance authority is immediately informed and the study is then conducted in accordance with the national rules governing clinical trials.

f.title: Monitor study data for benefit-risk impact; file an annual report with the ANPP; transmit new information immediately as an emerging safety issue
f.statement: The registration holder monitors the data generated during the study and evaluates their impact on the benefit/risk balance; the annual report must be filed with the ANPP. However, any new information that may affect it is transmitted immediately to the national competent pharmacovigilance authority as an emerging safety issue.

Toutefois, toute nouvelle information pouvant l’affecter est transmise immédiatement à l’autorité nationale compétente en pharmacovigilance comme problème de sécurité émergent.

f.title: Report study adverse effects/events to the CNPM and MIPh per protocol and regulations; state in the protocol if expedited reporting is not required
f.statement: Adverse effects or events are reported to the CNPM and the MIPh according to collection, management and notification procedures specified in the protocol and the regulations in force. A reference to the permanent PV system is possible, but study-specific details must be included. If expedited notification is not required, this must be specified in the protocol.

f.title: Apply the safety communication principles: clear, relevant, accurate, consistent, timely and audience-adapted messages
f.statement: The safety communication principles must be applied: communication must be clear, relevant, accurate and consistent, delivered at the right time to the targeted audiences to enable appropriate action, and messages must be adapted to the different audiences (patients, HCPs) according to their understanding and needs while keeping the information accurate.

f.title: Inform the CNPM at the same time as or before publicly disseminating PV concerns; same-time-only notification only exceptionally and justified
f.statement: As soon as a registration holder and/or operator plans to publicly disseminate information relating to pharmacovigilance concerns about the use of a pharmaceutical product, it must inform the CNPM at the same time as or before the public dissemination. • Information at the time of public dissemination (i.e. without prior notice to the CNPM) must only occur exceptionally and for justified reasons. • The registration holder must ensure that the information communicated to the public is objective and not misleading.

f.title: When aware a third party plans to disseminate benefit-risk information on a product authorised in Algeria, inform the CNPM and try to share the content
f.statement: When the registration holder becomes aware that a third party plans to disseminate information likely to affect the benefit/risk balance of a product authorised in Algeria, it must inform the CNPM and make every effort to share the content of the communication with it.

rows.actor: Registration holder

f.title: Notify emerging safety issues in writing to the CNPM immediately and at the latest within 5 working days of awareness; not as PSUR/ICSR
f.statement: Events or observations likely to affect the benefit/risk balance of a pharmaceutical product (emerging safety issues) must not be submitted as PSURs/ICSRs. They must be notified in writing to the CNPM as emerging safety issues immediately, and at the latest within 5 working days of the registration holder becoming aware of the publications or of implementation by other regulatory authorities where the product is marketed.

f.title: The ESI notification must state the concerns and proposed actions; analyse ESIs in the relevant PSUR/PBRER sections
f.statement: The notification document must indicate the points of concern and the proposed actions concerning the pharmaceutical product concerned. These safety issues must also be analysed in the relevant sections of the periodic safety update report (PSUR/PBRER) of the authorised product.

f.title: Applicants must immediately submit to the ANPP information affecting benefit-risk obtained between PV approval and MA grant
f.statement: Between approval of the pharmacovigilance part of the marketing authorisation application and the grant of the authorisation, the applicant is responsible for ensuring that any information (qualitative, non-clinical, clinical) that may influence the benefit/risk balance of the product under evaluation is immediately submitted to the ANPP.

Il incombe au demandeur de s'assurer que ces informations sont immédiatement soumises à l'ANPP.

f.statement: However, it must obtain the agreement of the CNPM on the content of a DHPC (and the communication plan) before its dissemination. f.title: For a DHPC published by the reference regulatory authority, use its template so all holders deliver a single consistent message

f.title: Applicants must immediately transmit any ESI or DHPC information to the competent authority even while the dossier is under evaluation

f.statement: The registration holder and/or operator submits the draft DHPC and the distribution ("recipient") list. f.title: Adapt the DHPC dissemination timetable to the urgency and choose a mechanism that respects it
f.statement: The dissemination timetable of the DHPC document must be adapted to the urgency of the safety issue. The dissemination mechanism of the DHPC document must be chosen appropriately to respect the dissemination timetable.

f.title: The holder may start disseminating the DHPC once the CNPM has approved content and communication plan

f.title: Notify the CNPM in good time, for approval, of important events during dissemination requiring plan changes or further communication
f.statement: Any important event or problem arising during the dissemination of the DHPC and revealing the need to modify the communication plan or to communicate further with healthcare professionals must be notified in good time to the CNPM for approval.
f.clause: X.13 Considérations pratiques – Traitement des DHPC

rows.deadline: In good time

f.title: Inform the CNPM when another country's authority requests DHPC dissemination on its territory

f.title: Notify the competent authorities of any new information likely to influence the benefit-risk balance (national legal obligation)
f.statement: This is part of the national legal obligation under which the registration holder and/or operator must notify the competent authorities of any new information likely to influence the benefit/risk balance of a pharmaceutical product.

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)

f.title: Communicate additional monitoring status to HCPs and patients to increase ADR reporting without undue alarm
f.statement: The additional monitoring status must be communicated to healthcare professionals and patients in a way that increases the reporting of suspected adverse reactions without creating excessive alarm.

f.title: Mandatory additional monitoring scope (new active substances and biologicals after 1 July 2025, PASS, specific obligations, conditional MAs)
f.statement: The following categories must be included in the additional monitoring list: products containing a new active substance not contained in any innovative product on 1 July 2025; any biological product not covered by that category and authorised after 1 July 2025; products for which a PASS was requested at or after marketing authorisation; products authorised with specific obligations concerning recording or suspected adverse reactions; products with a conditional marketing authorisation; products authorised under exceptional circumstances.
f.clause: XI.2 Considérations pratiques – 1.1 Champ d'application obligatoire

rows.actor: ANPP/CNPM (list); registration holders of listed products
rows.quote: Il est obligatoire d'inclure les catégories suivantes de produits pharmaceutiques dans la liste : • Produits pharmaceutiques contenant une nouvelle substance active qui, au 1er juillet 2025, n'était contenue dans aucun produit pharmaceutique innovant ; • Tout produit pharmaceutique biologique non couvert par la catégorie précédente et autorisé après le1er juillet 2025; • Produits pour lesquels une PASS (d'une étude de sécurité post-autorisation) a été demandée au moment de l'autorisation de mise sur le marché • Produits autorisés avec des obligations spécifiques concernant l'enregistrement ou les effets indésirables suspectés • Produits pour lesquels une PASS (une étude de sécurité post-autorisation) a été demandée après l'octroi de l'autorisation de mise sur le marché • Produits qui ont obtenu une autorisation de mise sur le marché conditionnelle • Produits autorisés dans des circonstances exceptionnelles.
rows.location: XI.2 Considérations pratiques – 1.1 Champ d'application obligatoire
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended to the conditional-MA bullet; the exceptional-circumstances bullet would take the quote past 1000 characters and is removed from the statement (flag for double-check). quote_en updated. rows.quote_en: It is mandatory to include the following categories of pharmaceutical products in the list: • Pharmaceutical products containing a new active substance which, on 1 July 2025, was not contained in any innovative pharmaceutical product; • Any biological pharmaceutical product not covered by the previous category and authorised after 1 July 2025; • Products for which a PASS (post-authorisation safety study) was requested at the time of marketing authorisation • Products authorised with specific obligations concerning recording or suspected adverse reactions • Products for which a PASS (post-authorisation safety study) was requested after the grant of the marketing authorisation • Products that have obtained a conditional marketing authorisation • Products authorised under exceptional circumstances.

f.title: ANPP may impose additional monitoring on products outside the mandatory scope
f.statement: The ANPP may impose additional monitoring on products outside the mandatory scope when a marketing authorisation is granted subject to conditions such as: conditions or restrictions on safe and effective use; measures for safe use to be included in the risk management system; an obligation to conduct a post-authorisation efficacy study; the existence of an adequate pharmacovigilance system.

f.title: If the list decision is taken during a regulatory procedure, update SmPC/leaflet before the procedure is finalised; otherwise submit a variation afterwards
f.statement: If the decision to include or remove a pharmaceutical product from the list is taken during the evaluation of a regulatory procedure (for example, marketing authorisation application, extension of indication, renewal), the SmPC and leaflet must be updated before finalisation of the procedure to include or remove the black triangle symbol and the explanatory statement from the product information. If the decision to include or remove a pharmaceutical product from the list is taken outside a regulatory procedure, the registration holder and/or operator is requested to subsequently submit a variation to update the product information accordingly.

f.title: Submit and distribute educational material separately from promotional material, clearly labelled as non-promotional
f.statement: The submission of educational material for review by the CNPM must be separate from the submission of promotional material, and a cover letter must clearly indicate whether the materials are promotional or educational. In addition, educational tools must be distributed separately from promotional materials as a "stand-alone" communication, and it must be clearly stated that the tools are not promotional material but rather have risk minimisation objectives.

f.title: Generics: evaluate RMM effectiveness in close cooperation with the CNPM; joint studies strongly encouraged
f.statement: For generic medicinal products, the effectiveness of risk minimisation measures must be evaluated by registration holders in close cooperation with the CNPM. Where formal studies are justified, joint studies for all pharmaceutical products concerned are strongly encouraged to minimise the impact on health systems.

f.statement: The applicant or registration holder and/or operator must report in the PBRER the results of the evaluation of the effectiveness of risk minimisation measures that could have an impact on the safety or benefit/risk evaluation.

f.statement: PBRER and RMP updates must include a summary evaluation of the outcome of the specific risk minimisation measures implemented to mitigate important risks in Algeria.

f.title: Always include RMM effectiveness results in the RMP and comment on factors of success or weakness
f.statement: The results of the evaluation(s) of the effectiveness of risk minimisation measures must always be included in the RMP. As part of this critical evaluation, the registration holder and/or operator must comment on the factors contributing to the success or weakness of the risk minimisation measures.
f.clause: XII.3 Impact de l’efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques sur le PGR/PBRER

Dans le cadre de cette évaluation critique, le détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE doit faire des observations sur les facteurs contribuant au succès ou à la faiblesse des mesures de minimisation des risques.

f.title: Present proposals to improve risk management in the PBRER national annex; update the RMP for emerging effectiveness information
f.statement: Proposals for changes to improve risk management must be presented in the national annex of the PBRER. The RMP must be updated to take account of emerging information on the effectiveness of risk minimisation measures.
f.clause: XII.3 Impact de l’efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques sur le PGR/PBRER
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Aggregate reporting; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Les propositions de modifications visant à améliorer la gestion des risques doivent être présentées dans l’annexe nationale du PBRER. Le PGR doit être mis à jour pour tenir compte des informations émergentes sur l’efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques.
rows.location: XII.3 Impact de l’efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques sur le PGR/PBRER

f.title: Keep RMP update frequency proportionate to risk; highlight significant RMP summary changes in the cover letter
f.statement: In general, the frequency of RMP updates must be proportionate to the risks of the product. RMP updates must focus on risk minimisation measures and on providing updates on the implementation of these measures, where applicable. If there is a significant change in the RMP summary, this must also be highlighted in the cover letter.
f.topic: RMP update frequency and cover letter
f.clause: XII.3 Impact de l’efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques sur le PGR/PBRER

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: En général, la fréquence des mises à jour du PGR doit être proportionnée aux risques du produit. L’accent des mises à jour du PGR doit être mis sur les mesures de minimisation des risques et sur la fourniture de mises à jour sur la mise en œuvre de ces mesures, le cas échéant. S’il y a un changement conséquent dans le résumé du PGR, cela doit également être mis en évidence dans la lettre d’accompagnement.

f.title: Do not propose product information changes via a stand-alone RMP update; use a variation application
f.statement: Changes to product information must not be proposed via a stand-alone RMP update; they must be the subject of a variation application.

f.title: Apply reference-product RMP updates equally to biosimilars and vice versa unless justified; full RMP for biosimilars
f.statement: In principle, any post-authorisation update of the risk management plan (RMP) for a reference product must be applied in the same way to biosimilars and vice versa, unless justified (all parts of an RMP – a full RMP – are required for a biosimilar, except Part II, module SI "Epidemiology of the target population").
f.clause: Annexe – 5. Produits Biologiques – 2.1 Système de gestion des risques
f.applicability: Biosimilars and their reference products
f.exceptions: Unless justified; Part II module SI not required for biosimilars

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: En principe, toute mise à jour post-autorisation du plan de gestion des risques (PGR) concernant un produit de référence doit être appliquée de la même manière aux biosimilaires et inversement, sauf justification (toutes les parties d’un PGR – un PGR intégral – sont requises pour un biosimilaire, à l’exception de la partie II, module SI « Épidémiologie de la population cible »).

f.title: State the origin of the biological active substance in RMP Part I; present infection/contamination risks from manufacturing in module SVI
f.statement: The origin of a biological active substance must be included as important information on its composition. RMP – Part II: "Safety specification" Module SVI: "Additional requirements for the safety specification" For all biological products, the potential risk of infections caused by residues of biological material used in the manufacturing process, as well as contaminations that may be introduced by that process, must be presented in relation to the potential risk of transmission of infectious agents.

f.applicability: Biological products

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: L’origine d’une substance active biologique doit être incluse en tant qu’information importante relative à sa composition. PGR – Partie II : « Spécifications de sécurité » Module SVI : « Exigences supplémentaires relatives aux spécifications de sécurité » Pour tous les produits biologiques, le risque potentiel d’infections causées par des résidus de matière biologique utilisés dans le procédé de fabrication, ainsi que les contaminations pouvant être introduites par ce même procédé, doivent être présentés en lien avec le risque potentiel de transmission d’agents infectieux.

f.title: Biosimilar summary of safety concerns at least identical to the reference product unless justified; address immunogenicity in the RMP
f.statement: For biosimilars, the summary of safety concerns must, at a minimum, be identical to that of the reference medicinal product, unless otherwise justified. Immunogenicity must be specifically addressed in this context and reflected in the risk management plan (RMP).

f.title: Biological PV plan must discuss clinical use contexts, name/batch recording and AESIs under specific monitoring
f.statement: In this context, the pharmacovigilance plan must include: a discussion of the clinical contexts of use of the product and of the potential impact on recording and reporting of the product name and batch numbers, as well as any adverse event of special interest (AESI), with their definitions, identified as an important potential risk and subject to specific safety monitoring set up for that purpose.

f.title: Include reference product RMMs in the biosimilar RMP and vice versa; justify any derogation
f.statement: Risk minimisation activities put in place for the reference medicinal product must, in principle, be included in the risk management plan (RMP) of the biosimilar, and vice versa. Any derogation from this principle (for example, when the risk minimisation is specifically linked to the reference medicinal product) must be duly justified.
f.clause: Annexe – 5. Produits Biologiques – Partie V du PGR
f.applicability: Biosimilars and their reference products

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Les activités de minimisation des risques mises en place pour le médicament de référence doivent, en principe, être incluses dans le Plan de Gestion des Risques (PGR) du biosimilaire, et inversement. Toute dérogation à ce principe (par exemple, lorsque la minimisation du risque est spécifiquement liée au médicament de référence) doit être dûment justifiée.

f.title: Holders of all biological products must manage ICSRs, submit PBRERs, run signal management, notify ESIs, monitor national and international literature
f.statement: Holders and/or operators of the registration decision of all biological products are required to: • manage individual case safety reports (ICSRs) • periodically submit the periodic benefit-risk evaluation report (PBRER) • fully implement signal management processes • notify emergency safety issues (ESIs) • exhaustively monitor the literature in national journals (in the countries where the product is marketed) and international reference journals • take into consideration any other pharmacovigilance activity required by the institutions of the national pharmacovigilance system.
f.clause: Annexe – 5. Produits Biologiques – Activités de pharmacovigilance post-commercialisation
f.applicability: Biological products
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Aggregate reporting; Signal management; Safety intake & collection

f.title: Annex-form route (Law 18-11): sponsor notifies serious or unexpected effects or new safety facts to the Minister immediately, at the latest within 7 days
f.statement: Annex-form route (Law No. 18-11 of 2 July 2018 on health, arts. 395 and 396, as amended): the sponsor is required to notify immediately any serious or unexpected adverse effect, or any new safety fact, occurring during or after the end of the study, to the minister in charge of the Pharmaceutical Industry, to the medical ethics committee for the clinical studies concerned and to all investigating physicians concerned, at the latest within seven (7) days.

f.title: Classify a reaction as serious if it meets a seriousness criterion, assessed at the time of the reaction
f.statement: A serious adverse reaction is any untoward medical occurrence that, at any dose, results in death, is life-threatening, requires or prolongs hospitalisation, results in significant or persistent disability or incapacity, or is a congenital anomaly/birth defect. These characteristics or consequences must be considered at the time the reaction occurred to determine its seriousness.

Les caractéristiques ou conséquences doivent être prises en compte au moment de la survenue de la réaction pour déterminer son caractère grave.

f.title: Record quality-defect details in the additional drug information field and justify company diagnosis
f.statement: For ADRs associated with a suspected or confirmed quality defect, the "Additional information on drug" field must be used for any relevant additional information (e.g. beyond expiry date, batch tested and found within/out of specification); an appropriate MedDRA term must be provided for the product characterisation in the "Reaction/event (MedDRA LLT)" field together with the resulting reaction; and, where applicable, the company diagnosis/reclassification element must be completed with a justification in the sender comments.

Ce champ de données peut également être utilisé pour fournir des informations supplémentaires concernant l’indication du médicament non couvertes dans l’élément de données « Indication d’utilisation dans le cas ». f.title: CNPM: set up a system to collect and record suspected ADR reports occurring on its territory
f.statement: The CNPM must set up a system for collecting and recording unsolicited and solicited reports of suspected adverse reactions occurring on its territory and brought to its attention by HCPs, consumers or registration holders, and must establish procedures to collect and record all such reports; the general principles and reporting arrangements must be applied to them.

rows.actor: CNPM (Centre National de Pharmacovigilance et de Matériovigilance)
rows.quote: • Le CNPM doit mettre en place un système de collecte et d’enregistrement des rapports non sollicités et sollicités de réactions indésirables suspectées qui surviennent sur son territoire et qui sont portés à son attention par les professionnels de la santé, les consommateurs ou les détenteurs de la DE. Dans ce contexte, le CNPM doit établir des procédures pour collecter et enregistrer tous les rapports de réactions indésirables suspectées qui surviennent sur son territoire. Les principes généraux ainsi que les modalités de déclaration doivent être appliqués à ces rapports.

f.title: CNPM: encourage and facilitate ADR reporting and publish the ways to report
f.statement: The CNPM must take all appropriate measures to encourage HCPs and consumers to report suspected adverse reactions, and must facilitate reporting through simple alternative reporting systems in addition to web-based formats. Information on the ways to report must be made public, including via national medicines web portals; organisations representing consumers and HCPs may be involved.
f.clause: VI.2.2 Rôles et responsabilités du CNPM

rows.quote: • Le CNPM doit prendre toutes les mesures appropriées pour encourager les professionnels de la santé et les consommateurs à signaler les réactions indésirables suspectées. • Le CNPM doit faciliter la déclaration des réactions indésirables suspectées au moyen de systèmes de déclaration alternatifs simples, accessibles aux professionnels de la santé et aux consommateurs, en plus des formats basés sur le web. Les informations sur les différentes façons de signaler les réactions indésirables suspectées liées aux produits pharmaceutiques doivent être rendues publiques, y compris au moyen de portails web nationaux sur les médicaments (sites web officiels). Pour accroître la sensibilisation aux systèmes de déclaration, les organisations représentant les consommateurs et les professionnels de la santé peuvent être impliquées, le cas échéant.

f.title: DSUR must cover safety information from all ongoing and completed sponsor trials and studies
f.statement: The DSUR must provide safety information from all ongoing clinical trials and other studies that the sponsor conducts or completed during the review period, including: clinical trials with an investigational product (phase I-III); trials with marketed products in approved indications (phase IV); therapeutic use of investigational products; trials supporting manufacturing process changes; and any other significant finding relevant to the safety of investigational products.

rows.quote: Le DSUR doit fournir des informations de sécurité provenant de tous les essais cliniques en cours et d'autres études que le promoteur mène ou a terminées pendant la période d'examen, y compris : 1. Les essais cliniques utilisant un produit expérimental (c'est-à-dire la pharmacologie humaine, les essais exploratoires thérapeutiques et les essais de confirmation thérapeutiques [Phase I - III]) ; 2. Les essais cliniques menés avec des produits médicaux commercialisés dans des indications approuvées (c'est-à-dire les essais d'utilisation thérapeutique (Phase IV)) ; 3. L'utilisation thérapeutique de produits expérimentaux ; 4. Les essais cliniques menés pour soutenir des changements dans le processus de fabrication des produits pharmaceutiques ; 5. Toute autre découverte significative pertinente pour la sécurité des produits expérimentaux.

f.title: Examine the impact of PBRER data and conclude on needed changes and actions incl. SmPC implications
f.statement: Within the PBRER, the registration holder is required to examine the impact of the data and evaluations presented. f.title: Provide an integrated benefit-risk evaluation, not a repeat of earlier PBRER sections
f.statement: In the PBRER section "Integrated benefit-risk analysis for authorised indications", the holder or operator must provide an overall evaluation of the benefits and risks of the product as used in clinical practice; the section must critically analyse and integrate key information from earlier sections and must not simply reproduce the risk and benefit characterisations (sub-sections 16.4 and 17.3).

rows.quote: Le détenteur ou exploitant de la DE doit fournir dans cette section du PBRER une évaluation globale des bénéfices et des risques du produit pharmaceutique tel qu'il est utilisé dans la pratique clinique. Alors que les sous-sections 16.4 ("Caractérisation des risques") et 17.3 ("Caractérisation des bénéfices") présentent les risques et les bénéfices, cette section doit fournir une analyse critique et une intégration des informations clés des sections précédentes et ne doit pas simplement reproduire la caractérisation des bénéfices et des risques présentés dans les sous-sections susmentionnées.

f.title: Evaluate and present benefit-risk per indication and, where it differs, per population
f.statement: Benefit-risk is specific to an indication and population: for products authorised in more than one indication, the benefit-risk balance must be evaluated and presented for each indication individually, and where there are important differences between populations within an indication, it must be presented by population where possible.

rows.quote: Le rapport bénéfice/risque est spécifique à une indication et à une population. Par conséquent, pour les produits autorisés dans plus d'une indication, le rapport bénéfice/risque doit être évalué et présenté pour chaque indication individuellement. S'il existe des différences importantes dans le rapport bénéfice/risque entre les populations d'une même indication, l'évaluation du rapport bénéfice/risque doit être présentée par population, si possible.

f.title: Explain the methodology and reasoning of the benefit-risk evaluation; exclude economic considerations
f.statement: The holder or operator must clearly explain the methodology and reasoning used for the benefit-risk evaluation: assumptions, considerations and judgement or weighting supporting the conclusions must be clear; if a formal quantitative or semi-quantitative evaluation is provided, a summary of the methods must be included; economic considerations (e.g. cost-effectiveness) are not taken into account.

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Le détenteur ou exploitant de la DE doit fournir une explication claire de la méthodologie et du raisonnement utilisés pour élaborer l'évaluation des bénéfices et des risques : • Les hypothèses, les considérations et le jugement ou la pondération qui étayent les conclusions de l'évaluation des risques et des bénéfices doivent être clairs. • Si une évaluation quantitative ou semi-quantitative formelle des bénéfices et des risques est fournie, un résumé des méthodes doit être inclus. • Les considérations économiques (par exemple, le rapport coût-efficacité) ne sont pas prises en compte dans l'évaluation du rapport bénéfice-risque.

f.title: Present risks with benefits, address uncertainties and communicate risks of no treatment
f.statement: In safety communications, risks must be presented in relation to the benefits of the medicine, specifying their seriousness, frequency, risk factors, reversibility and time to onset and recovery; uncertainties must be addressed rigorously without causing confusion, especially at the preliminary stage of signal analysis; where relevant, risks of no treatment must also be communicated.

f.statement: A safety communication must contain: important new information, or a reminder of important information, on any authorised product affecting its benefit-risk balance whatever the conditions of use; a clear explanation to the target audience of why the communication was initiated; any recommendations to HCPs and patients on how to handle the safety issue; information on any proposed change to product information (SmPC, leaflet); and a reminder to report suspected adverse reactions to the national spontaneous reporting systems.

rows.quote: Par conséquent, compte tenu des dispositions ci-dessus et des principes énoncés au point 10.1.2, la communication sur la sécurité doit contenir : • De nouvelles informations importantes ou un rappel d'informations importantes sur tout produit pharmaceutique autorisé ayant un impact sur le rapport bénéfice/risque du médicament, quelles que soient les conditions d'utilisation ; • La raison pour laquelle la communication sur la sécurité a été initiée est clairement expliquée au public cible ; • Toute recommandation aux professionnels de la santé et aux patients sur la manière de traiter un problème de sécurité ; • Des informations sur toute proposition de modification des informations relatives au produit (par exemple, le résumé des caractéristiques du produit (RCP) ou la notice) ; • Un rappel de la nécessité de notifier les effets indésirables suspectés conformément aux systèmes nationaux de notification spontanée.

f.title: Other circumstances that may justify a DHPC
f.statement: Other circumstances may justify disseminating a DHPC: important new warnings or precautions in the product information; data identifying a new risk or changing the frequency or severity of a known risk; data questioning the expected efficacy; new recommendations to prevent or manage adverse reactions or avoid medication errors; ongoing evaluation of an important potential risk where data are not yet sufficient for regulatory action (in that case the DHPC must encourage close monitoring and reporting and may give information on minimising the potential risk).

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: D’autres circonstances peuvent justifier la diffusion d’un DHPC : • Nouvelles mises en garde ou précautions d’emploi importantes dans les informations du produit pharmaceutique. • Données identifiant un nouveau risque ou modifiant la fréquence ou la gravité d’un risque connu. • Données remettant en question l’efficacité attendue du médicament. • Nouvelles recommandations pour prévenir ou gérer des effets indésirables, ou éviter les erreurs médicamenteuses. • Évaluation en cours d’un risque potentiel important, pour lequel les données disponibles à un actuellement sont insuffisantes pour justifier une action réglementaire (dans ce cas, la DHPC doit encourager la surveillance rapprochée de ce problème de sécurité en pratique clinique et inciter à la notification, et éventuellement fournir des informations sur la manière de minimiser le risque potentiel).

f.title: Determine risk minimisation measures per safety concern, considering severity, preventability and context
f.statement: On the basis of the safety concerns in the safety specification, appropriate risk minimisation measures must be determined. Each safety concern must be considered individually, and selection of the most appropriate measure must take into account the seriousness and severity of potential adverse reactions, their preventability or the clinical actions required to mitigate the risk, the indication, route of administration, target population and healthcare context.

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Sur la base des problèmes de sécurité décrits dans la spécification de sécurité, les mesures de minimisation des risques appropriées doivent être déterminées. Chaque problème de sécurité doit être examiné individuellement et la sélection de la MMR la plus appropriée doit prendre en compte la gravité des effets indésirables potentiels et leur sévérité (impact sur le patient), de leur caractère évitable ou les actions cliniques requises pour atténuer le risque, l'indication, la voie d'administration, la population cible et le contexte des soins de santé pour l'utilisation du produit.

Each safety concern must be examined individually and the selection of the most appropriate RMM must take into account the seriousness of the potential adverse reactions and their severity (impact on the patient), their preventability or the clinical actions required to mitigate the risk, the indication, the route of administration, the target population and the healthcare context for the use of the product.

f.title: Prioritise safety concerns and use additional RMMs only where routine measures are insufficient
f.statement: To decide whether additional risk minimisation is needed, safety concerns must be prioritised by frequency, seriousness, public health impact and preventability; it should then be considered whether routine measures suffice and, if not, which additional measures are most appropriate. Additional measures must focus on the most important and preventable risks, and their burden must be balanced against the benefit for patients.
f.clause: XII.1.1 Principes généraux

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Pour déterminer si des activités de minimisation des risques supplémentaires sont nécessaires, les problèmes de sécurité doivent être hiérarchisés en termes de fréquence, de gravité, d’impact sur la santé publique et de prévention. Il convient ensuite d’examiner attentivement si l’objectif peut être atteint avec des activités de minimisation de routine et, si elles ne sont pas jugées suffisantes, quelle(s) mesure(s) de minimisation supplémentaire(s) est (sont) la (les) plus appropriée(s). Les MMRs doivent se concentrer sur les risques les plus importants et évitables, et l’impact d’imposer une minimisation des risques supplémentaire doit être équilibré avec le bénéfice pour les patients.
rows.location: XII.1.1 Principes généraux

rows.quote_en: To determine whether additional risk minimisation activities are necessary, safety concerns must be prioritised in terms of frequency, seriousness, public health impact and preventability. It is then appropriate to examine carefully whether the objective can be achieved with routine minimisation activities and, if they are not considered sufficient, which additional minimisation measure(s) is (are) the most appropriate. Additional RMMs must focus on the most important and preventable risks, and the impact of imposing additional risk minimisation must be balanced with the benefit for patients.

f.title: Give additional RMMs clear objectives and success criteria and monitor their implementation and effectiveness
f.statement: Additional risk minimisation measures must have a clearly defined objective relevant to minimising specific risks and/or optimising benefit-risk; clear objectives and defined success criteria with milestones must guide their development, and their implementation and ultimate effectiveness must be closely monitored.
f.clause: XII.1.1 Principes généraux

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: À cette fin, elles doivent avoir un objectif clairement défini, pertinent pour la minimisation de risques spécifiques et/ou l’optimisation de la balance bénéfice/risque. Des objectifs clairs et des critères de réussite définis, avec des étapes clés, doivent guider le développement des mesures supplémentaires de minimisation des risques. Leur mise en œuvre et leur efficacité finale doivent faire l’objet d’un suivi étroit.

f.title: Describe each additional RMM in the RMP: rationale, objectives and description
f.statement: Introducing additional risk minimisation measures must be approached as a programme with specific tools, an implementation scheme and an evaluation strategy. Their description in the RMP must therefore cover: the rationale (a justification must be provided); objectives (each proposed measure must have clearly defined objectives and a precise description of the safety concern addressed and how); and a description of the selected measures, including the tools and key content elements.
f.clause: XII.1.1 Principes généraux

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: L’introduction de mesures supplémentaires de minimisation des risques doit être envisagée comme un « programme », dans lequel des outils spécifiques sont développés, accompagnés d’un schéma de mise en œuvre et d’une stratégie d’évaluation. La description des mesures de minimisation des risques, partie intégrante du plan de gestion des risques (PGR), doit donc tenir compte des points suivants : •Justification (le motif) : Lorsque des MMRs sont introduites, une justification doit être fournie pour ces mesures supplémentaires ; •Objectifs : chaque mesure supplémentaire proposée doit inclure des objectifs clairement définis et une description précise du problème de sécurité concerné et de la manière dont il est traité ; •Description : Cette section du PGR doit décrire les MMRs sélectionnées, y compris les outils qui seront utilisés et les éléments clés du contenu ;

The description of the risk minimisation measures, an integral part of the risk management plan (RMP), must therefore take into account the following points: • Justification (the rationale): when additional RMMs are introduced, a justification must be provided for these additional measures; • Objectives: each proposed additional measure must include clearly defined objectives and a precise description of the safety concern concerned and how it is addressed; • Description: this section of the RMP must describe the selected additional RMMs, including the tools that will be used and the key content elements;

f.title: Introduce additional RMMs only when indispensable, developed by qualified persons
f.statement: Whereas routine measures apply to every product, additional risk minimisation activities must only be introduced when they are considered indispensable for the safe and effective use of the product, and they must be developed and made available by suitably qualified persons.

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Alors que les mesures de routine s’appliquent à tout produit pharmaceutique (voir les détails dans le chapitre « Systèmes de gestion des risques »), les activités supplémentaires de minimisation des risques ne doivent être introduites que lorsqu’elles sont jugées indispensables pour l’utilisation sûre et efficace du produit pharmaceutique, et elles doivent être élaborées et mises à disposition par des personnes dûment qualifiées.

f.title: Keep educational material consistent with approved product information and free of promotion
f.statement: The content of any educational material must fully comply with the currently approved product information (SmPC, leaflet) and complement rather than duplicate it. Direct or disguised promotional elements (e.g. logos, brand colours, suggestive images) must not be included, and content must focus on the product risk(s) and their management requiring additional measures. Any educational programme must be completely separate from promotional activities, and physician or patient contact details collected through it must not be used for promotional purposes.

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Le contenu de tout support éducatif doit être entièrement conforme aux informations sur le produit actuellement approuvées pour le médicament, telles que le Résumé des Caractéristiques du Produit (RCP) et la notice, et doit compléter ces informations plutôt que les dupliquer. Les éléments promotionnels, qu’ils soient directs ou dissimulés (par exemple logos, couleurs de marque du produit, images ou illustrations suggestives), ne doivent pas être inclus, et le contenu du support éducatif doit se concentrer sur le ou les risques liés au produit ainsi que sur leur gestion nécessitant des mesures supplémentaires de minimisation des risques. Tout programme éducatif doit être complètement séparé des activités promotionnelles et les coordonnées des médecins ou des patients recueillis par le biais de programmes éducatifs ne doivent pas être utilisées à des fins promotionnelles.

f.title: Restrict controlled access programmes to major risks with serious consequences
f.statement: A controlled access programme must only be put in place to reduce a major risk that may have serious consequences for public health or the patient; it concerns only medicines with well-established benefits that can be used safely only if patients meet specific conditions before prescription or dispensing.

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)

Ce type de programme ne concerne que les médicaments dont les bénéfices sont bien établis, mais qui ne peuvent être utilisés en toute sécurité que si les patients remplissent certaines conditions précises avant la prescription ou la délivrance du produit

f.title: Evaluate effectiveness per tool and per programme at the right time and plan periodic reviews
f.statement: Effectiveness evaluation must be carried out for each additional risk minimisation tool individually and for the programme as a whole, at the most appropriate time (taking account of time to launch the measures, estimated product use and other circumstances); a periodic review of the effectiveness of specific tools or the overall programme must also be planned.

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: L’évaluation doit être effectuée pour les outils de minimisation des risques supplémentaires individuellement et pour le programme de minimisation des risques dans son ensemble. L’évaluation de l’efficacité doit être menée au moment le plus approprié, en tenant compte du temps nécessaire au lancement des mesures de minimisation des risques, de l’utilisation estimée du produit par le système de santé et d’autres circonstances pertinentes. Un examen périodique de l’efficacité d’un ou plusieurs outils spécifiques ou du programme global, selon le cas, doit également être planifié.

A periodic review of the effectiveness of one or more specific tools or of the overall programme, as appropriate, must also be planned.

f.title: Use process and outcome indicators; identify implementation indicators in advance
f.statement: To evaluate the effectiveness of additional risk minimisation measures, two categories of indicators must be considered: process indicators and outcome indicators. Process indicators must show the extent to which the programme was executed as planned and whether intended behavioural impacts were observed; implementation indicators must be identified in advance and tracked over time.
f.clause: XII.1.4 Efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques

rows.actor: Registration holder and/or operator (détenteur et / ou exploitant de DE)
rows.quote: Pour évaluer l’efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques supplémentaires, deux catégories d’indicateurs doivent être considérées : • Indicateurs de processus ; • Indicateurs de résultats. Des indicateurs de processus sont nécessaires pour recueillir des preuves que les étapes de mise en œuvre des mesures supplémentaires de minimisation des risques ont été menées avec succès. Ces indicateurs de processus doivent fournir un aperçu de la mesure dans laquelle le programme a été exécuté comme prévu et si les impacts prévus sur le comportement ont été observés. Les indicateurs de mise en œuvre doivent être identifiées à l’avance et suivies au fil du temps.

rows.quote_en: To evaluate the effectiveness of additional risk minimisation measures, two categories of indicators must be considered: • Process indicators; • Outcome indicators. Process indicators are necessary to gather evidence that the implementation steps of the additional risk minimisation measures have been carried out successfully. These process indicators must provide an overview of the extent to which the programme was executed as planned and whether the intended impacts on behaviour were observed. The implementation indicators must be identified in advance and followed over time.

f.statement: If a study is conducted to evaluate behavioural indicators or safety outcomes of risk minimisation, the recommendations for conducting a post-authorisation safety study must be followed; they do not apply to measuring simple process indicators (e.g. distribution of tools reaching the target population).

Ces recommandations ne s’appliquent pas à la mesure de simples indicateurs de processus (par exemple, la distribution des outils atteignant la population cible).

f.title: Use a consistent, CNPM-coordinated approach to additional RMMs across generics of the same substance
f.statement: Where several generics of the same active substance are on the market, there must be a consistent approach to additional risk minimisation measures, coordinated and supervised by the CNPM. Where coordinated action for a product class is needed, a harmonised approach must be agreed where appropriate, and advance planning must ensure that effectiveness can be considered for each product and for all products together.

Lorsqu’une action coordonnée pour une classe de produits est nécessaire, une approche harmonisée doit être convenue, le cas échéant. Dans ces circonstances, une planification avancée doit garantir que l’efficacité des mesures de minimisation des risques peut être prise en compte pour chaque produit individuel ainsi que pour l’ensemble des produits.

In the PBRER there must also be an evaluation of the impact of the measures implemented on the safety profile and/or benefit-risk balance, focusing in general on information that emerged during the reporting period or since implementation of the most recent risk minimisation measure(s) in Algeria; where a PBRER and an RMP update are submitted in parallel, the use of a common content chapter must be considered.

En général, l’accent doit être mis sur les informations qui ont émergé pendant la période de rapport ou depuis la mise en œuvre de la ou des mesures de minimisation des risques les plus récentes en Algérie. f.title: For EUL/derogatory or accelerated authorisations: report non-serious adverse effects within 7 days
f.statement: In certain exceptional situations, in particular for medicinal products or vaccines authorised under derogatory or accelerated authorisation procedures (e.g. Emergency Use Listing - EUL), specific notification timelines must be respected. Registration holders are required to report any non-serious adverse effect within a period not exceeding 7 days.
f.clause: VI.1.2.1 Délais de soumission des ICSR – Situations particulières
f.applicability: Medicinal products or vaccines authorised under derogatory or accelerated procedures (e.g. EUL)

rows.actor: Registration holder
rows.deadline: Non-serious: max 7 days (clock start not stated)
rows.quote: Dans certaines situations exceptionnelles, notamment pour les médicaments ou particulières vaccins autorisés dans le cadre de procédures d’autorisation dérogatoire ou accélérée (ex : Emergency Use Listing – EUL), des délais spécifiques de notification doivent être respectés. Les détenteurs de la DE sont tenus de signaler : • Tout effet indésirable grave dans un délai maximal de 24 heures à compter de la prise de connaissance. • Tout effet indésirable non grave dans un délai ne dépassant pas 7 jours. • Le rapport final validé doit être soumis dans un délai n’excédant pas 15 jours.
rows.location: VI.1.2.1 Délais de soumission des ICSR – Situations particulières

f.title: CNPM route: send available additional information on fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within a further 8 days
f.statement: CNPM route (section VI.2.2.4): any SUSAR occurring during a clinical trial must be reported to the CNPM in accordance with the regulatory timelines (ref. ICH E2A). For fatal or life-threatening SUSARs, the available additional information must be transmitted within a further eight (8) days.
f.clause: VI.2.2.4 Déclaration des cas issus des essais cliniques
f.applicability: Clinical trials; SUSARs reported to the CNPM (VI.2.2.4)

rows.actor: Clinical trial sponsor
rows.deadline: Additional information: within a further 8 days (after the 7-day initial report period)
rows.quote: Tout effet indésirable grave et inattendu (SUSAR – Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction) survenant au cours d’un essai clinique doit être déclaré au Centre National de Pharmacovigilance et de Matériovigilance (CNPM) conformément aux délais réglementaires (Références: ICH E2A – Clinical Safety Data Management: Definitions and Standards for Expedited Reporting) • Sans délai et au plus tard dans les sept (7) jours suivant la date à laquelle le promoteur a eu connaissance du cas, pour les effets indésirables mortels ou mettant en jeu le pronostic vital, GUIDE DE BONNES PRATIQUES DE PHARMACOVIGILANCES 113 avec transmission des informations complémentaires disponibles dans un délai supplémentaire de huit (8) jours ;
rows.location: VI.2.2.4 Déclaration des cas issus des essais cliniques

rows.quote_en: Any serious and unexpected adverse reaction (SUSAR – Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction) occurring during a clinical trial must be reported to the National Pharmacovigilance and Materiovigilance Centre (CNPM) in accordance with the regulatory timelines (References: ICH E2A – Clinical Safety Data Management: Definitions and Standards for Expedited Reporting) • without delay and at the latest within seven (7) days of the date on which the sponsor became aware of the case, for fatal or life-threatening adverse reactions, [page header] with transmission of the available additional information within a further eight (8) days;

f.title: Submit PBRERs within 90 calendar days of DLP (intervals over 12 months)
f.statement: Each holder of a registration decision is responsible for submitting PBRERs for all its products once a registration decision has been granted, in accordance with the following timelines: within 90 calendar days following the DLP (day 0) for PBRERs covering intervals of more than 12 months.
f.clause: VII.1 Introduction

rows.actor: Registration holder
rows.deadline: 90 calendar days after DLP (day 0) for intervals over 12 months
rows.quote: Chaque détenteur d'une DE est responsable de la soumission des rapports PBRER pour tous ses produits une fois qu'une DE a été accordée, conformément aux délais suivants : • Dans les 70 jours calendaires suivant le DLP (data lock point) (jour 0) pour les PBRER couvrant des intervalles allant jusqu'à 12 mois (y compris des intervalles d'exactement 12 mois) ; et • Dans les 90 jours calendaires suivant le DLP (jour 0) pour les PBRER couvrant des intervalles de plus de 12 mois ;
rows.location: VII.1 Introduction
rows.review_note: Split from DZ-BPPV-V2-0316 (deadline pass); same quote. Deadline rule: "jours calendaires" stated. Double-check: Translation verified (quote_en faithful; level matches the French modal). Quote alone proves the modal verb, actor and statement.
rows.quote_en: Each holder of a registration decision is responsible for submitting PBRERs for all its products once a registration decision has been granted, in accordance with the following timelines: • Within 70 calendar days following the DLP (data lock point) (day 0) for PBRERs covering intervals of up to 12 months (including intervals of exactly 12 months); and • Within 90 calendar days following the DLP (day 0) for PBRERs covering intervals of more than 12 months;

deadline_rule.applies_to: PBRERs covering intervals of more than 12 months
